AcceptedAttachmentDescriptor.description: Immutable accepted photo/file association; contains no storage locator, source URL or applicant credential.

attachmentId.description: Opaque identifier allocated by the source and bound to this handoff.

fieldPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer relative to the accepted Response.data value, not the Response root. D1 photo is /photo; a repeated nested photo is /household/0/photo. Preserve the actual traversal pointer with ~0/~1 escaping; no dot-path conversion or /data prefix. Source must resolve Response.data.pointer(fieldPath) to the exact accepted attachment descriptor.

fileName.description: Filename from the exact accepted Response attachment descriptor, frozen at acceptance. This is the name as filed; it does not assert the upload-time filename.

hash.description: SHA-256 of original attachment bytes, checked on each source read.

mediaType.description: Retained MIME media type, independently checked before serving bytes.

AcceptedAuthoredArtifact.description: Immutable authored artifact actually used by the accepted filing; never the current active artifact.

document.description: Exact parsed retained owner-native document. Source validates the kind-specific canonical Formspec schema; no rewritten fields.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact retained raw UTF-8 artifact bytes.

AcceptedIntakeEvidence.description: Source-owned immutable accepted evidence returned by the protected service resolver. Native JSON is opaque to WOS code generation, but must pass canonical Formspec validation and cross-field qualification before acceptance.

artifacts.description: Additional authored artifacts actually used for this accepted rendering; no speculative inventory.

items.description: Retained artifact.
Original attachment metadata.

definition.description: Exact Definition artifact; kind must be definition and URL/version match Response and handoff.

definitionHash.description: Maintained canonical semantic Definition hash, distinct from raw artifact hash.

displayedLocale.description: Exact recorded Locale; kind locale and URL/version/language agree with accepted Response.displayedLocale. Omit only when inline Definition wording was actually displayed.

handoff.description: Exact canonical IntakeHandoff1.0, unchanged, including original session and genuine material-history head. Optional actorRef/subjectRef may be omitted; no invented nulls or new members.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

materialHistory.description: Actual retained RespondentLedger material history selected by ledgerHeadRef, with genuine event/session/Response/report association. Does not assert anchoring.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

originalEvaluation.description: Exact original source evaluation receipt (values/validations/etc), retained unchanged. This is not the canonical ValidationReport; canonical report is derived once from that same actual result, clock and pinned Definition through the maintained Formspec builder.

response.description: Exact full accepted Response, including original signatures, pins and answers; validate maintained full responseHash.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

validationReport.description: Original retained report selected by handoff validationReportRef; never reevaluated at read time.

x-wos.validationOwner: Formspec trusted accepted-evidence resolver; WOS must refuse unqualified source values

AcceptedSignatureVerification.description: Original source verification facts. Acceptance, pseudonymous session custody and full Response hash do not prove civil identity.

details.description: Exact retained source verifier details; not a newly generated legal or identity assertion.

keyId.description: Actual verification key pin when a key was used.

signedPayloadDigest.description: Original signed-payload digest, distinct from the full accepted Response hash.

status.description: Actual source verifier result; verified requires successful configured verification of the original authored signature.

ActorRef.description: Stable actor reference from the identity/governance subsystem (ADR 0082 D-9). The principal-class segment is the closed VISION §V taxonomy `human | service-account | workload | support`. Identity details live once in the identity/governance subsystem; every record references actors by URN. Replaces the legacy nested `actor: {id,type,name}` shape from prior portal art.

ActorScope.description: Public scope-membership view resolved from the authenticated internal principal and authoritative membership grants. Tenant/organization/workspace/environment describe membership, not permission supplied by a caller or identity-provider claim. This is distinct from the internal tenant/workspace/environment/cell deployment binding and case chain identity; servers must resolve their explicit mapping before authorizing storage or case access.

environment.description: Closed deployment stage: sandbox (dev/test), staging (pre-prod), prod (live). This stage is not an opaque internal EnvironmentId. A configured explicit mapping relates the internal environment identifier to its stage; no string equality or fallback grants are implied.

organization.description: Organization identifier — product-ownership boundary where forms, cases, and members live (VISION §V; ADR 0068 D-1 (Accepted)). Object-ownership and deletion-follows-org invariants tie retention to this id, not to billing state.

tenant.description: Tenant identifier — outermost hosting/commercial boundary (VISION §V; ADR 0068 D-1 (Accepted)). Hosting-tier identity, not user-visible.

workspace.description: Optional workspace identifier — sub-scope inside an organization (VISION §V). Omitted when the actor is bound at the organization level.

AgentDriftStatus.description: Current drift posture of an agent's deployed model relative to its calibration baseline (governance S2 driftMonitoring). Closed-with-vendor-extension enum (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals: `nominal` (drift signals within calibration window), `watch` (drift trending toward the recalibration threshold but not yet breached), `recalibration-required` (drift exceeded the threshold; agent SHOULD be recalibrated before further use), `demoted` (governance suspended the agent's autonomy until recalibration), `unknown` (no drift observation available — typical for newly-declared agents). Vendor extensions MUST use an `x-` prefix.

AgentShadowModeDivergenceInput.description: Input parameters for the agent-shadow-mode-divergence report (advanced/advanced-governance.md shadow mode; advanced-governance.md:370-385). Counts and characterises divergence between the shadow agent's outputs and the baseline (human reviewer or production model) over the requested time window.

agentId.description: Optional agent URN to restrict the report to a single shadow agent.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the agent-shadow-mode-divergence input variant.

timeRange.description: UTC time window over which divergence comparisons are aggregated.

workflowUrl.description: Author-time workflow URL to scope the report to. Omit to span all visible workflows.

AgentShadowModeDivergenceRow.description: Per-agent result row for the agent-shadow-mode-divergence report (advanced/advanced-governance.md shadow mode; advanced-governance.md:370-385).

agentId.description: Agent URN this row is attributed to.

averageDivergenceMagnitude.description: Mean normalized disagreement magnitude across diverging comparisons. Method-specific units; consult the workflow's shadow-mode declaration.

baselineModelIdentifier.description: Identifier of the baseline the shadow agent was compared against (`human` for human-reviewer baseline, otherwise a model identifier). Open identifier — projected from the agent's `shadowMode.baselineModelIdentifier`.

comparisonsCount.description: Number of shadow-vs-baseline comparisons observed within the window.

divergenceCount.description: Number of comparisons whose normalized disagreement exceeded the agent's `shadowMode.divergenceThreshold`.

divergenceRate.description: Divergence rate in [0,1] for this agent within the window — `divergenceCount / comparisonsCount`.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the agent-shadow-mode-divergence row variant.

AggregationGranularity.description: Closed time-bucket granularity for time-series report inputs. Bucket boundaries are aligned to UTC calendar units.

AiOverrideRateInput.description: Input parameters for the AI override-rate report. Counts reviewer overrides of agent decisions per agent over the requested time window.

agentId.description: Optional agent URN to restrict the report to a single declared agent.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the AI override-rate input variant.

timeRange.description: UTC time window over which override counts are aggregated.

workflowUrl.description: Author-time workflow URL to scope the report to. Omit to span all visible workflows.

AiOverrideRateRow.description: Per-agent result row for the AI override-rate report.

agentId.description: Agent URN this row is attributed to.

decisionsCount.description: Number of agent decisions observed within the window.

overrideCount.description: Number of reviewer overrides recorded for this agent within the window.

overrideRate.description: Reviewer override rate in [0,1] for this agent.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the AI override-rate row variant.

ApplicantAgentSummary.description: Single agent's role in this case as projected for the applicant view (EU AI Act Art. 13; OMB M-24-10; ai-integration.md §12.1-§12.2 line 592-604). The applicant has the right to know that AI participated and in what capacity, but NOT to know the model identifier, version, internal autonomy posture, or proprietary configuration. This shape carries only the disclosure-load-bearing fields.

confidence.description: Reported calibrated confidence of the agent's contribution to this case in [0,1]. Optional — surfaced only when the agent reported a confidence and disclosure policy permits showing it; absent otherwise.

displayName.description: Plain-language agent label suitable for applicant rendering ("Eligibility Assistant", not `claude-sonnet-4-20250514`). Open prose — the staff `AgentView.modelIdentifier` is intentionally NOT projected here.

roleInDecision.description: Closed-no-extension role classification matching the disclosure obligation. `advisory` is suggest-only or read-only assistance; `primary` is the agent that produced the determination input (autonomous or supervised); `fallback` is an agent that ran only when an upstream actor failed. The applicant has authority to know which of the three roles the AI played — closed by design so the disclosure cannot drift into vendor-specific labels.

ApplicantAiInvolvementSummary.description: Applicant-facing summary disclosing AI involvement on this case (EU AI Act Art. 13 transparency obligation to the affected person; OMB M-24-10; ai-integration.md §12.1-§12.2 line 592-604: "For `rights-impacting` workflows, `discloseThatAgentAssisted` MUST be `true`"). Surfaces the FACT of AI involvement and the operational shape that bears on appeal rights — agent count, role, narrative-record count for further inquiry, and whether human review covered every agent decision — without leaking model identifiers, internal model parameters, or the underlying autonomy enum. Present on `ApplicantCaseDetail` iff the governing workflow's `aiOversight.disclosure.discloseThatAgentAssisted` is true.

agentsInvolved.description: Agents whose actions contributed to this case, ordered by `roleInDecision` (`primary` first, then `advisory`, then `fallback`). Empty when no agent participated despite the workflow declaring AI capability — disclosure on a per-case-actual-involvement basis is the regulatory obligation.

humanReviewedAllAgentDecisions.description: True when every agent action on this case was followed by recorded human review per the workflow's review-protocol obligation. False signals that at least one agent action took effect without per-action human review (`autonomous` autonomy with after-the-fact review or sample-based review). Load-bearing for the applicant's ability to assess appeal grounds and for the staff's confidence in the determination chain.

narrativeRecordCount.description: Count of narrative-tier provenance records on this case (ai-integration.md §13). The applicant uses this as a hint for further inquiry — "there are 3 narrative records about this case" — without exposing the record contents themselves at this projection.

ApplicantCaseDetail.description: Full applicant-visible case projection returned by `GET /api/v1/applicant/cases/{id}`. Wraps a `summary` envelope (the same shape returned by the list endpoint), the applicant-owed open task set, the most recent applicant notifications for this case, and the bounded status timeline. Holds, delegations, review state, governance internals, and other staff-only subresources are NOT exposed; the applicant view is intentionally narrower than staff `WorkflowProcessWithIncludes`.

aiInvolvement.description: EU AI Act Art. 13 / OMB M-24-10 disclosure of AI involvement on this case (ai-integration.md §12.1-§12.2 line 592-604). Present iff the governing workflow's `aiOversight.disclosure.discloseThatAgentAssisted` is true. Exposes the FACT of AI involvement and the operational shape (agent count, role, human-review coverage, narrative-record count) — never internal model identifiers or autonomy enums. Closes the structural disclosure gap on the applicant-facing surface.

openTasks.description: Applicant-owed tasks currently in `pending` or `drafted` status, ordered by `deadline` ascending then `createdAt` ascending. Bounded set per case; the dedicated subresource `GET /api/v1/applicant/cases/{id}/tasks` is the cursor-paginated form for cases with many historical tasks.

recentNotifications.description: Most recent applicant notifications scoped to this case, ordered by `createdAt` descending. Bounded by server-side cap (typically the most recent 20). Full feed at `GET /api/v1/applicant/notifications`.

statusTimeline.description: Applicant-visible status timeline for this case, ordered by `occurredAt` ascending. Bounded set per case (governed events the applicant has authority to see).

summary.description: Case summary envelope — same shape as the list-view item, repeated for self-containment.

ApplicantCaseListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page (ADR 0082 D-7).

ApplicantCaseSummary.description: Lightweight applicant-facing case projection for list views. Distinct from staff `instance.schema.json#/$defs/WorkflowProcess` — the applicant view hides governance internals (delegations, review state, hold rationale) and surfaces only the fields the applicant has authority to see. Carries the case URN, governing workflow, lifecycle posture, last-update timestamp, and an `actionNeeded` flag indicating whether at least one applicant-owed task is in `pending` or `drafted` status.

actionNeeded.description: True when at least one applicant-owed task on this case is currently in `pending` or `drafted` status (i.e. the applicant has work outstanding). Computed server-side.

continuationOfServicesActive.description: True when the case is operating under a continuation-of-services policy (governance §3.6 — `AppealMechanism.continuationOfServices`; workflow-governance.md:154-158). Surfaces the existence of the policy without leaking the underlying rationale; the applicant has unambiguous authority to see this fact because it directly bears on whether benefits continue during appeal.

continuationOfServicesEndsAt.description: Absolute UTC RFC 3339 timestamp at which the active continuation-of-services window closes, or the literal `never` for indefinite continuation (governance §3.6; ADR 0082 D-10 sentinel pattern). Present only when `continuationOfServicesActive == true`.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the case was created.

id.description: Stable public URN for this workflow process.

lifecycleState.description: Closed lifecycle posture for this case (projected from `instance.schema.json`).

title.description: Short human-readable case label suitable for list rendering. Sourced from the workflow's case-file `caseLabel` mapping when configured; falls back to a workflow-name-based default. Open prose — rendering concern.

updatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent applicant-visible update.

workflowUrl.description: Absolute URI of the governing Workflow Document.

ApplicantCaseSummaryPage.description: Cursor-paginated applicant case page (ADR 0082 D-7). Default ordering is `updatedAt` descending so applicants see their most recently active cases first.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Applicant case summaries in this page.

ApplicantNotificationListItem.description: Thin applicant-scoped projection of a notification feed item. The full staff `notification.schema.json#/$defs/Notification` shape carries fields (rich actions, internal severity ladder, governance-source classifiers) that exceed the applicant's authority. This projection keeps identity, type, status, headline, body, and case linkage — sufficient to drive an applicant inbox without leaking governance internals. Authoring lives here (rather than a `$ref` to staff notification) because the applicant view is intentionally narrower and uses a smaller closed `kind` taxonomy.

body.description: Notification body text suitable for in-app display.
examples: We need additional information to continue your application.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the notification was created.

id.description: Stable public URN for this notification.

kind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension applicant-facing notification family (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals are the applicant-relevant projection of staff event families: `task-assigned` (new applicant-owed task); `task-deadline-approaching` (advance SLA warning); `case-update` (lifecycle posture change visible to the applicant); `correspondence-received` (inbound message addressed to the applicant); `decision-reached` (rights-impacting determination available). Staff-internal categories (`escalation`, `review-activated`, `hold-expired`) are filtered server-side and MUST NOT appear here. Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this notification relates to. Omitted only for tenant-wide system notifications.

readAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the applicant marked the notification read. Omitted while `status == unread`.

status.description: Closed applicant-side read status. Closed-no-extension by design — the applicant inbox lifecycle is normative. Note this is a strict subset of `notification.schema.json#/$defs/NotificationStatus`: the staff `dismissed` status is not exposed because applicant notifications are never dismissed administratively, only read or archived by the applicant.

taskId.description: Task URN this notification relates to. Present iff `kind` is `task-assigned` or `task-deadline-approaching`.

title.description: Short headline suitable for inbox-style display.
examples: New task assigned: submit eligibility application

ApplicantNotificationListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page (ADR 0082 D-7).

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Applicant notifications in this page.

ApplicantStatusTimelineEntry.description: Single entry in the applicant-visible status timeline. Each entry is an applicant-scoped projection of a governed event — case-creation, lifecycle-state change, applicant-task assignment, applicant-task submission, decision, correspondence sent or received. Closed-with-vendor-extension `event` taxonomy. The timeline is NOT a cursor-paginated list (entry count is bounded per case); it ships as a small array on `ApplicantCaseDetail.statusTimeline` and not as a standalone endpoint.

event.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension applicant-visible event class. Reserved literals project the events the applicant has authority to see; staff-internal events (delegation, review-flagged, hold-engaged rationale) are filtered server-side. Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix.

newLifecycleState.description: New lifecycle posture entered as a result of this event. Present iff `event == lifecycle-changed`.

occurredAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the event was recorded server-side.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the event suitable for timeline rendering. Open prose — rendering concern.

taskId.description: Task URN this entry relates to. Present iff `event` is `applicant-task-assigned` or `applicant-task-submitted`.

ApplicantTaskPage.description: Cursor-paginated applicant-owed task page returned by `GET /api/v1/applicant/cases/{id}/tasks` (ADR 0082 D-7). Items are `ApplicantTaskSummary` projections — applicant-owed tasks only.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Applicant task summaries in this page.

ApplicantTaskSummary.description: Subset of staff `task.schema.json#/$defs/TaskListItem` projected for the applicant view. Only applicant-owed tasks are returned by `GET /api/v1/applicant/cases/{id}/tasks`; the contract defends that scope by carrying a closed `TaskKind` subset (`intake`, `correspondence-response`, `signature`, `verification`) covering applicant-actionable families and a closed user-facing `TaskStatus` (`pending | drafted | submitted | dismissed | expired`). Staff-owned task families (`review`, `determination`, `escalation`, `hold-resolution`) are filtered server-side and never appear here.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task was created.

deadline.description: UTC RFC 3339 deadline by which the applicant SHOULD submit the response before SLA breach (governance S10.3).

id.description: Stable public URN for this task.

kind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension task family for applicant-owed work (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals are the applicant-actionable subset of `task.schema.json#/$defs/TaskKind`: `intake` (initial application capture); `correspondence-response` (reply to inbound correspondence); `signature` (signature-profile signer step); `verification` (independent confirmation of a prior mutation). Staff-owned families (`review`, `determination`, `escalation`, `hold-resolution`) are filtered server-side and MUST NOT appear here. Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this task belongs to.

status.description: Closed user-facing task posture, mirroring `task.schema.json#/$defs/TaskStatus` (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals `pending | drafted | submitted | dismissed | expired`. The `pattern` branch is a forward-compatibility seam only — `task.schema.json#/$defs/TaskStatus` itself is closed-no-extension; vendor extensions are intentionally not exercised here.

title.description: Short human-readable task headline (open prose; rendering concern, not contract).

updatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task projection was last refreshed.

ApplicationCaseReceipt.description: Reports the durable application case without claiming intake acceptance.

ApplicationCaseStatus.description: Separates application progress from completed governed intake acceptance.

AssembledExplanation.description: Server-assembled adverse-decision explanation (governance §3.8; workflow-governance.md:166-238). The §3.8.1 algorithm's output structure — Reasoning records ordered by authority rank + Counterfactual records partitioned positive/negative + assembly metadata — projected as a typed read-only resource so clients do not re-implement the deterministic-assembly MUST. Returned by `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/processes/{process_id}/explanation`. Two conformant processors MUST produce the byte-identical assembled explanation from the same provenance log (workflow-governance.md:170).

assembledAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the assembly algorithm ran (governance §3.8.1 step 5 `assembledAt`).

assembledBy.description: Actor URN that ran the assembly. Typically a `workload` principal-class actor representing the runtime; manual re-assembly by a human is permitted and would carry that actor's URN.

factsTrace.description: Ordered URNs of the Facts-tier provenance records the assembly walked (governance §3.8.1 step 1 — `provenanceLog.filter(tier="facts")` ordering preserved). Lets clients verify the explanation's input set against the per-process provenance feed.

narrative.description: Structured natural-language explanation rendered from the ordered reasoning + counterfactual material (governance §3.8.3 — "a JSON structure, not rendered text" applies to the underlying records; this `narrative` is the rolled-up prose the host renders for the applicant). Open prose.

negativeCounterfactuals.description: Irrelevant factors — including protected characteristics — that did NOT affect the outcome (governance §3.8.1 step 3, §6.4).

positiveCounterfactuals.description: Controllable factors that would change the outcome (governance §3.8.1 step 3, §6.4). Empty for non-rights-impacting workflows.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this explanation was assembled for. Entity-type segment MUST be `process`.

rulesApplied.description: Rules applied across the determination, ordered by authority rank descending (governance §3.8.2 — `statute > regulation > policy > guideline`). Cross-`$ref`s `RuleReference` from this same schema rather than redefining (ADR 0082 D-14).

transitionId.description: Optional identifier of the transition that produced the adverse decision (governance §3.8.3). Surfaced for cross-reference against the instance's lifecycle log; omitted when assembly was triggered outside a single-transition context.

AssertionGateKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension assertion-gate kind (governance §5.4 Assertion Gates; workflow-governance.md:293-305). Reserved literals enumerate the seven gate kinds the spec table at §5.4 normates: `source-grounded` (extracted values must appear in source), `arithmetic` (recomputation check), `range` (bounds check), `consistency` (cross-stage non-contradiction), `format` (parse check), `cross-document` (multi-document consistency), `temporal` (date/time ordering). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix per ADR 0082 D-12. A regulator querying "every pipeline stage that failed an `arithmetic` gate" reads this taxonomy directly.

AssertionGateResult.description: Single assertion-gate evaluation result (governance §5.4; workflow-governance.md:293-305). Each pipeline stage's gate evaluation produces one of these — closed-taxonomy gate kind + pass/fail boolean + structured evidence references. Embedded as an optional array on `ReasoningTierRecord.assertionGates` so an auditor walking the reasoning trace can answer "which gate kind failed at this stage and what evidence backs the failure?" without re-deriving from open-prose `criteriaChecked.detail`.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail explaining the gate result. Free-form prose for cases where the structured evidence does not carry the full story.

evidenceRefs.description: Structured evidence references supporting the gate's pass/fail finding (governance §5.4 — "each gate produces a pass/fail result with structured evidence"). Empty when the gate verification did not surface specific evidence references (typical for `format` parse checks); populated for `source-grounded`, `cross-document`, and `consistency` gates whose evidence is referenceable.

gateKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension classification of which §5.4 gate produced this result.

gatePassed.description: True when the gate's verification method (governance §5.4 third column) returned pass; false when it returned fail. The pipeline's risk profile is determined by the weakest gate (workflow-governance.md:309), so any false here load-bears.

stageId.description: Optional pipeline-stage identifier this gate evaluation belongs to. Useful when multiple gates fire in one stage and consumers want to correlate by stage.

AssignmentRoles.description: Five-role task-assignment projection (governance §7.2 separation of duties + §10.2 assignment roles; workflow-governance.md:392-396 + 502-514). Surfaces the kernel's task-management role taxonomy so a staff portal can answer "who is excluded?", "who is the required owner?", "which actor pool may claim?", "who currently holds the task?", and "who delegated it?" without re-deriving from delegation graphs and provenance. Closed object — adding a new role requires a schema major bump; the precedence rule from workflow-governance.md:514 (`excludedOwner` overrides all other roles) is enforced at the runtime, not in the projection.

businessAdministrator.description: Actor URN who can reassign, delegate, or escalate this task without performing it (workflow-governance.md:511). Typically a supervisor or governance officer. Absent when the workflow does not declare a business administrator on this task pattern.

currentAssignee.description: Actor URN currently responsible for the task (`Task.assignedActor` mirror — projected here for shape symmetry). Updated on delegation or escalation.

delegatedFrom.description: Actor URN that delegated this task to the current `currentAssignee`. Mirrors `Task.delegatedFrom`; surfaced under `assignmentRoles` so consumers reading the role projection do not need to cross-reference the parent task's top-level fields.

eligiblePool.description: Actor URNs in the eligible pool — first-claim-wins per workflow-governance.md:510 (`potentialOwner` role). Empty when the task uses single-actor assignment.

excludedOwner.description: Actor URN explicitly excluded from assignment to enforce separation of duties (governance §7.2; workflow-governance.md:512). Per workflow-governance.md:514 this overrides all other roles — an actor appearing here MUST NOT be assigned even if otherwise eligible. Absent when no exclusion applies.

requiredOwner.description: Actor URN required to be the owner of this task. Maps to the kernel `owner` role (workflow-governance.md:508) when the workflow declaration pins a specific actor; absent when the task uses a pool-based assignment instead.

AudienceProjection.description: Optional audience-driven field projection block. CBR §4.4 architectural commitment: one case view, two audience-appropriate routes. The staff route at `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}` MAY surface fields suppressed on the applicant route at `GET /api/v1/applicant/cases/{id}`; the projection block records the resolved audience tier and any field-level redaction the responding deployment applied. This is the ONLY allowed asymmetry between replay-read and projection-read for the byte-identity acceptance fixture (CBR §4.7) — every other field MUST byte-match across read paths. `additionalProperties` is permitted under the `x-` prefix only (open-with-vendor-extension per ADR-0082 D-12).

^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Vendor extension (open-with-`x-` per ADR-0082 D-12). Deployments may attach audience-tier debug metadata under an `x-` key; consumers MUST tolerate unknown extensions.

audience.description: Closed audience taxonomy for the responding view. `staff` is the default for `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}` (caseworker / supervisor / adjudicator). `applicant` is reserved for cross-tier reuse; the applicant route returns a distinct `ApplicantCaseDetail` shape. `support` is the human-in-the-loop assistance tier.

redactedFields.description: Field paths suppressed from `events[].payload` (or other case-view subtrees) by the responding deployment's class-bag policy. Paths are JSON Pointer fragments rooted at the response document. Empty array when no redaction applied.

AuditQueryRequest.description: Cross-case audit query request body for `POST /api/v1/audit/queries`. Submits a parameterised query against the cross-case provenance corpus and (when `materialize: true`) requests durable result storage so a long-running query can be polled and paginated. The query envelope is closed: every filter is named and scoped; there is no open `criteria: Record<string, unknown>` bag.

actorRef.description: Optional actor URN filter — restrict the query to records whose `actorRef` equals this principal (ADR 0082 D-9). Identity-attestation investigations use this filter against a specific subject.

instanceScope.description: Optional instance scope — restrict the result set to records belonging to one or more named workflow processes. Empty array is forbidden. When omitted the query spans every visible instance in scope.

materialize.description: When true, the server materializes the result set so it can be paginated across multiple GET requests. When false (default), the query executes synchronously and `POST /api/v1/audit/queries` returns the first page directly. `Idempotency-Key` is REQUIRED when `materialize: true` (ADR 0082 D-16) because materialization is an externally-visible side effect.

maxResults.description: Hard upper bound on the result set, applied after every other filter. Servers MAY enforce a smaller per-deployment ceiling. The page size is governed by `limit` on the result endpoints; this bound caps the total result corpus the query materializes.

recordKindFilter.description: Optional record-kind filter — restrict the result set to one or more Facts-tier `recordKind` literals (e.g., `identityAttestation`, `signatureAffirmation`, `caseStateMutation`). Cross-`$ref`s the closed-with-vendor-extension `FactsRecordKind` taxonomy from `provenance.schema.json`.

scope.description: Tenant / Organization / Workspace / Environment scope (ADR 0068 D-2 Proposed). Tenant is REQUIRED; cross-tenant queries are refused at the runtime.

sort.description: Result-set ordering. Defaults to `timestamp-desc` when omitted.

tierFilter.description: Optional tier filter — restrict the result set to one or more provenance tiers. Empty array is forbidden; omit the field to span all four tiers.

timeRange.description: Optional UTC RFC 3339 time-range filter against the provenance record `timestamp` field. Omitted to span the full retention window.

end.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 upper bound for the audit window.

start.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 lower bound for the audit window.

AuditQueryResult.description: Cross-case audit query result envelope. Cursor-paginated per ADR 0082 D-7. `items` are projected `ProvenanceRecord` instances cross-`$ref`ed from `provenance.schema.json` — the per-case shape is the audit shape; there is no second meaning of `record`.

completedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the query reached its terminal status. Omitted while `status in {pending, running}`.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

failure.description: Failure detail when `status == failed`. Carries a stable WOS error code plus human-readable text drawn from the public registry (`error-registry.md`).

wosErrorCode.description: Stable WOS error code from the public error registry that classifies this failure.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Projected provenance records in this page. Each item is a full tier-discriminated `ProvenanceRecord` from `provenance.schema.json` — no separate `audit-record` type is invented (audit is cross-case provenance, not a different shape).

queryId.description: Server-issued opaque identifier for the materialized query, used to fetch subsequent pages and to cancel. Empty / synchronous queries (when `materialize: false`) MAY return a stable identifier the client can ignore.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the underlying materialized query. Synchronous queries (when `materialize: false`) return `succeeded` directly.

submittedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the query was accepted by the server. Useful for reproducibility — a query submitted at instant T against a tenant with active appends MAY return different rows than one submitted at T+1.

AuditQuerySort.description: Closed sort taxonomy for cross-case audit results. `timestamp-asc` = oldest record first (chronological investigations); `timestamp-desc` = newest first (recent-activity reviews). Closed enum with no extension seam — sort orders are normative and a verifier MUST be able to reproduce a result set deterministically.

AuditQueryStatus.description: Closed lifecycle status for a deferred audit query. `pending` = queued, not yet started; `running` = executing; `succeeded` = first page available; `failed` = terminated with error; `cancelled` = caller cancelled before completion.

AuditScopeFilter.description: Closed scope filter for cross-case audit queries. Filters the query to a Tenant / Organization / Workspace / Environment slice per VISION §V scope hierarchy. The shape gates on ADR 0068 D-2 (Proposed) — when ADR 0068 promotes to Accepted, this object becomes the wire form audit scope is reported in. Until then, server implementations MAY accept only the fields they have settled. Cross-tenant audit is structurally inexpressible by construction: a tenant filter is REQUIRED, and the runtime refuses cross-tenant reads (ADR 0068 D-1).

environment.description: Closed deployment environment filter. New environments require a major schema bump (no extension seam).

organization.description: Optional organization identifier filter — product-ownership boundary (ADR 0068 D-1 (Proposed)). Restricts the result set to one organization within the tenant.

tenant.description: Tenant identifier filter — outermost hosting/commercial boundary (ADR 0068 D-1 (Proposed)). REQUIRED. The runtime refuses queries whose `tenant` does not match the caller's authenticated tenant scope.

workspace.description: Optional workspace identifier filter — sub-scope inside an organization (VISION §V).

AuditTierFilter.description: Closed provenance-tier filter. The four tiers correspond to Kernel S8 (Facts), Governance S6.2 (Reasoning), Governance S6.4 (Counterfactual), and AI Integration S13 (Narrative). Filter aligns with the `tier` discriminator on `provenance.schema.json#/$defs/ProvenanceRecord`.

AuthAssuranceLevel.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension authentication-assurance level (ADR 0082 D-12), aligned with the IdentityAttestation `assuranceLevel` taxonomy from ADR 0068 D-3.1 (Accepted). Reserved literals: `low` (single-factor, low-assurance); `standard` (single-factor with proven possession, e.g. password + verified email); `high` (multi-factor with at least one phishing-resistant factor, e.g. WebAuthn); `very-high` (hardware-bound, identity-proofed). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix.

AuthorizationRejectedRecord.description: Typed public payload for `FactsTierRecord.authorizationRejectedRecord` when `event == "wos.governance.authorization_rejected"` (ADR 0070 D-3). Captures who attempted which action against which resource and why policy denied it.

attemptedAction.description: Action attempted by the actor, using the runtime's verb:resource convention.

attemptedActorRef.description: Actor URN that attempted the rejected action.

policyDecisionRef.description: Optional provenance or audit resource URN for the policy-engine decision that denied the attempt.

rejectionReason.description: Human-readable reason policy rejected the authorization attempt.

targetResourceRef.description: Resource URN the rejected action targeted.

BundleCompletedNotification.description: Retained notification arm for `type == bundle-completed`, not emitted by the current server. `bundleId` remains REQUIRED for this arm. It refers to the retired case-export resource, not GET /api/v1/bundles loaded workflows; current case exports use completion-exports.schema.json (ADR 0164).

action.description: Primary action the client can expose for this notification.

actorRef.description: Actor associated with this notification when the projection has a single responsible actor.

body.description: Notification body text suitable for in-app display.
examples: Your case-export bundle is available for download.

bundleId.description: Bundle resource associated with this notification — REQUIRED on this arm. The entity-type segment MUST be `bundle`.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the notification was created.

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry timestamp or the literal never for non-expiring notifications.

id.description: Stable public URN for this notification.

processId.description: Workflow process resource associated with this notification when applicable.

readAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the user marked the notification read. Omitted while unread.

severity.description: User-facing urgency level for ordering and presentation.

source.description: Producer family that emitted or projected this notification.

status.description: Current user-specific read lifecycle.

taskId.description: Task resource associated with this notification when applicable.

type.description: Discriminator literal for the bundle-completion arm.

BusinessCalendarDate.description: Single calendar-day entry returned by the business-calendar lookup endpoint (delivery sidecar §business-calendar; specs/sidecars/business-calendar.md §3 work week + §4 holiday schedule). Carries the date, its closed-no-extension day kind, and the optional holiday name. Lets a portal display "is today a business day?" or "what's the next business day?" without re-implementing the workWeek + holidays composition logic.

date.description: ISO 8601 date this entry classifies. Interpreted in the calendar's declared `timezone` (specs/sidecars/business-calendar.md §2.1 timezone).

dayKind.description: Closed-no-extension classification of the day. `business` matches the §3.3 evaluation (in `workWeek` AND not in `holidays`); `holiday` is in `holidays` regardless of `workWeek` (§4); `weekend` is outside `workWeek` and not declared as a holiday. Closed by design — adding a kind requires a schema major bump.

holidayName.description: Human-readable holiday name from the calendar's `holidays[].name` (specs/sidecars/business-calendar.md §4.1). Present iff `dayKind == "holiday"`. Open prose.

observed.description: True when this entry is the observed-date for a holiday whose nominal date falls on a non-working day (specs/sidecars/business-calendar.md §4.3). Absent or false on non-observed entries.

BusinessCalendarDateList.description: Cursor-paginated business-calendar date page (ADR 0082 D-7). Returned by `GET /api/v1/correspondence/calendar/{calendarId}/dates?from=...&to=...`. Days are returned in chronological order by `date` ascending. Calendars with thousands of entries (multi-year ranges) page; small ranges fit a single response.

calendarId.description: Calendar identifier this page belongs to (matches the `{calendarId}` path parameter and the delivery sidecar's calendar block).

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

items.description: Date entries in this page, ordered by `date` ascending. Each entry classifies one calendar day in the requested `from`..`to` range.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the calendar declares (specs/sidecars/business-calendar.md §2.1). Surfaced once on the page envelope so consumers do not need to re-resolve the calendar block to interpret day boundaries.

CancelReportRunRequest.description: Request body for cancelling a pending or running report run. An empty body is acceptable; reason is optional context.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason recorded with the run.

CaseAuditRecord.description:
Returns current native case facts under current completion read permissions.

No task grant or final completion/export result is implied by this record.

CaseExportFence.description: WOS-side source fence for a case-export attempt. Captures the current case-ledger and policy/config high-water marks before downstream bundle assembly.

capturedAt.description: Server clock at fence acquisition (RFC 3339 UTC).

caseLedgerId.description: Durable governed case-ledger URN whose append vector this fence captures.

directHighWater.description: Last direct-append event at fence acquisition. Absent when the case has no direct-append rows.

eventCount.description: Total merged event count at fence acquisition. Verifiers MUST observe the same count in the bundle event stream.

eventHighWater.description: Last event in the merged case stream at fence acquisition. Absent when the case has no events.

policySnapshotDigest.description: Canonical digest of `{ caseLedgerId, policySources }` at fence acquisition.

policySources.description: Provenance for policy materials that contributed to `policySnapshotDigest`.

processHighWater.description: Per-process high-water cursor for every workflow process bound to the case. Empty when no processes exist.

trellisScope.description: Trellis scope identifier for the case ledger's bundle scope (string-encoded scope bytes).

CaseFenceEvent.description: High-water event marker used by the case export fence.

eventId.description: Storage-local provenance row identifier for the high-water event.

processId.description: Emitting workflow process URN when the high-water event is process-scoped. Absent for direct-append high-water markers.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the emitting partition at fence acquisition.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the row was appended.

CaseFileRead.description: Authorized staff read of the immutable initial filing and actual WOS identities. This is separate from mutable runtime case state.

caseLedgerId.description: Actual accepted durable case ledger URN.

intake.description: Immutable initial accepted source snapshot, qualified and durably associated with this case.

processId.description: Actual process created for this intake.

tasks.description: Immutable original task inventory from committed intake creation facts. Empty only when those facts establish no tasks were created, including while checks are queued; later tasks require separately authorized task API reads.

items.description: Maintained task read shape.

CaseFileSnapshot.description: Canonical case-file snapshot captured at determination time (kernel S8.2.1). Mirrors `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/CaseFileSnapshot`.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of jcsCanonical.

value.description: Raw case-file JSON value observed immediately before the determination transition fires.

CaseStateValue.description: Current case-file field values, carried as an opaque JSON value (typically an object whose keys are case-file field names declared in the governing Workflow Document's `caseFile.fields` per Kernel S5.2). The case-file shape is workflow-defined, not API-defined: per-workflow structural validation is the reference server's responsibility against the resolved Workflow Document; this contract treats the value as opaque-shaped. Mutation projection is via `CaseStateMutation`, whose `mutationKind` and `verificationLevel` taxonomies are closed (ADR 0082 D-6).

CaseStatus.description: Closed case-level rollup posture. `active` — at least one bound workflow process is non-terminal (active, suspended, migrating). `closed` — every bound workflow process reached a terminal lifecycle state (completed, terminated, stalled). `genesis` — the case ledger exists via the direct-append surface but no workflow process is bound yet. The taxonomy is closed-no-extension; pre-release framing forbids `x-` vendor extensions here.

CaseView.description: Staff case view returned by `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}` per CBR §4.5. Keyed by the durable case ledger; aggregates every bound workflow process URN and the merged provenance event stream. The `processes` array carries process URNs only (full process projections live at `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/processes/{process_id}`). The `events` array is the merged time-ordered stream across direct-append rows and every bound process's per-process provenance. `lastUpdated` is the timestamp of the most recent event (or the case-ledger genesis timestamp when no events exist beyond genesis). Replay-vs-projection byte-identity is required for the Phase 5 N:1 conformance fixture; `audienceProjection` is the only allowed asymmetry between the two read paths.

audienceProjection.description: Audience-projection metadata. Optional; the only allowed asymmetry between replay-read and projection-read for the byte-identity fixture.

caseLedgerId.description: Durable governed case-ledger URN (`urn:wos:<tenant>_case_<ulid>`). The case IS its ledger (CBR §1; ADR-0093 D-1).

events.description: Merged time-ordered provenance event stream across direct-append rows and every bound process. Direct-append events have no `processId`; process-emitted events carry the emitting process URN. Sort order is primary by `timestamp` ascending, secondary by `sequence` ascending. This array is the load-bearing byte-identity surface for the Phase 5 replay-vs-projection conformance fixture.

lastUpdated.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent event in the merged stream. When `events` is empty (an impossible state under the 404 contract — the case view 404s when there are no processes AND no events), this field is absent.

processes.description: Workflow process URNs bound to this case ledger, sorted by `created_at` then `process_id`. Empty for a direct-append case with no workflow started yet. Full process projections are NOT inlined here; consumers fetch them via `GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/processes/{process_id}` (D-3 subresource discipline). N:1 (N processes per one case) is supported from day one per CBR §3.

status.description: Case-level lifecycle rollup. See `CaseStatus` for the closed taxonomy.

CaseViewEvent.description: One event in the merged time-ordered event stream for the case view. Direct-append events (no `processId`) and process-emitted events (with `processId`) share this shape so replay and projection return byte-identical event arrays. `event` is the closed WOS event-type literal (CBR §4 closed enum; F-13 naming convention). `sequence` is monotonic within the case ledger; `eventHash`/`previousHash` are the Trellis-style chain commitments.

event.description: Registered WOS event literal carried by the provenance payload. Authoritative D26 dispatch value; the inner `recordKind` discriminator is intentionally suppressed in the merged case view. Absent only when the underlying provenance row predates the closed-enum migration (legacy rows; not emitted by greenfield write paths).

processId.description: Workflow process URN that emitted this event when present. Absent for direct-append events written through `POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/events`. The presence/absence of this field is the structural marker for the emission branch (CBR §4.6 two-branch authorization).

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the case ledger's merged event stream. Direct-append rows partition on `case_ledger_id`; process-emitted rows partition on `process_id` but are still anchored to the case ledger and ordered by `timestamp` then `sequence` in this view.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the row was appended. Primary sort key for the merged stream.

CaseloadSummaryInput.description: Input parameters for the caseload-summary report. Counts open and closed instances grouped by lifecycle outcome and optional workflow scope.

groupByOutcome.description: When true, rows are partitioned by terminal outcomeCode (Kernel S6 final-state outcomeCode). When false or omitted, rows aggregate across outcomes.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the caseload-summary input variant.

timeRange.description: UTC time window over which caseload counts are aggregated.

workflowUrl.description: Author-time workflow URL to scope the report to. Omit to span all visible workflows.

CaseloadSummaryRow.description: Per-bucket or per-outcome result row for the caseload-summary report.

closedCount.description: Number of instances closed within the window for this row.

newlyOpenedCount.description: Number of instances newly created within the window for this row.

openCount.description: Number of instances open at the end of the window for this row.

outcomeCode.description: Final-state outcomeCode (Kernel S6) when groupByOutcome was true. Omitted on aggregate rows.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the caseload-summary row variant.

CircuitBreakerEventRecord.description: Typed public payload for `circuitBreakerTripped` and `circuitBreakerReset` Facts records. Captures the governed agent breaker state transition and the threshold evidence behind it.

action.description: Circuit-breaker action represented by the parent record category.

agentRef.description: Agent resource URN whose circuit breaker changed state.

breakerId.description: Identifier of the configured circuit breaker.

cooldownUntil.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp after which the breaker may attempt half-open recovery.

failureRate.description: Observed failure rate in the evaluation window, when available.

status.description: Breaker status after the action.

threshold.description: Configured failure-rate threshold that tripped or governed the reset.

CompletionExportJob.description: Durable whole-case completion export job. Exactly three states: running, succeeded, failed.

oneOf.description: The server holds the export and no custody receipt or failure is recorded yet. The caller can leave the page and poll later.

jobId.description: Server-minted export job identity as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; the status and download path parameter.

processId.description: Canonical full URN of the actual workflow process.

status.description: Closed job state: running, succeeded or failed.

oneOf.description: The retained custody receipt for this job exists; the archive is ready at the download path.

checkpointRef.description: Retained checkpoint reference of the receipt-pinned archive.

jobId.description: Server-minted export job identity as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; the status and download path parameter.

processId.description: Canonical full URN of the actual workflow process.

status.description: Closed job state: running, succeeded or failed.

oneOf.description: Retries ended or the job was refused, with a stable failure code.

failureCode.description: Stable failure code. forbidden: current permission refused or operator cancel; refused: retained evidence or qualification refused; conflict: changed inputs; retries-exhausted: server-side retries ended within the bounded window; receipt-missing: the job recorded success but custody holds no receipt (an integrity fault to report, not to retry).

jobId.description: Server-minted export job identity as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; the status and download path parameter.

processId.description: Canonical full URN of the actual workflow process.

status.description: Closed job state: running, succeeded or failed.

CompletionExportJob.title: CompletionExportJob

CompletionExportJobList.description: Running and finished export jobs for one process and caller.

jobs.description: The caller's jobs for the process, newest first.

CompletionExportJobList.title: CompletionExportJobList

CompletionExportRequest.description: One actual workflow process selector for a completion export job. The current human credential is a transport input for the request only; the server mints the job identity and a signed job grant.

processId.description: Actual workflow process selected by full process URN or bare process TypeID.

ConfidenceReport.description: Canonical reported confidence accompanying native agent output; computed decay, cumulative confidence and floor decisions remain separate evaluation evidence.

^x-.description: Descriptive vendor metadata retained verbatim without granting runtime authority.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the reported confidence factors, preserved without changing the score.

additionalProperties.description: Reported confidence for the named output field, preserved as supplied.

fieldLevel.description: Reported per-output-field confidence values, each finite and between zero and one.

method.description: How the reported confidence was derived; a claim does not establish trusted calibration.

overall.description: Reported estimated probability that a competent reviewer would accept this output unchanged.

ConfigurationStateId.description: Single active leaf-state identifier in the kernel lifecycle hierarchy (Kernel S4.2). Dot-separated path of the leaf state within the lifecycle (for example `review.initial`).

ContentRef.description: Claim-check pointer to the actual correspondence payload. The payload is never embedded in the API resource; this URI MUST resolve through the bundle service or an authenticated agency document store. Format-restricted to absolute URI to prevent open-string `Record<string, unknown>` style escape hatches.

CorrespondenceListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page (ADR 0082 D-7).

CorrespondenceMessage.description: Public WOS correspondence message: a single inbound or outbound communication associated with a workflow process. The `contentRef` field is a claim-check pointer; payload bytes never travel through this API resource.

actorRef.description: Actor responsible for sending or recording this message when one applies.

contentRef.description: Claim-check pointer to the message payload (rendered notice PDF, scanned mail image, email blob, transcript, etc.).

deliveryChannels.description: Outbound delivery channels the agency intends to use for this message. Omitted for inbound messages.

direction.description: Direction of this message relative to the agency.

expiresAt.description: Optional retention horizon. UTC RFC 3339 timestamp or the literal `never` for indefinite retention (ADR 0082 D-10).

id.description: Stable public URN for this correspondence message.

occurredAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the correspondence event occurred (mailed, received, phone-call ended).

partyRole.description: Role of the party who sent or received this message.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this correspondence belongs to.

producer.description: Producer family that authored or ingested this message.

recordedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the server recorded this correspondence message.

relatedNotificationId.description: Optional WOS notification URN this correspondence was projected into the user feed under.

relatedTaskId.description: Optional WOS task URN this correspondence relates to.

renderingId.description: When this message was produced from a delivery-template rendering, the rendering's URN. Absent for raw-logged inbound messages.

status.description: Current delivery lifecycle of this message.

subject.description: Optional subject line for outbound messages or extracted subject for inbound messages.

summary.description: Required human-readable one-line summary of this correspondence event for case timelines and audit logs.
examples: Adverse benefits decision notice mailed to applicant

templateRef.description: Delivery-sidecar template identifier this message conforms to.

workflowUrl.description: Workflow URI used to resolve the delivery sidecar templates referenced by this message.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Correspondence messages in this page, ordered by `occurredAt` descending unless the server documents otherwise.

CorrespondencePartyRole.description: Role of the party who sent or received the correspondence. Closed projection of the delivery sidecar `correspondenceRole` enum (https://wos-spec.org/schemas/delivery/1.0#/$defs/EntryTemplate/properties/correspondenceRole).

x-lm.intent: Identifies the correspondence party role for this category (Delivery §4.2)

CorrespondenceRendering.description: Result of rendering a delivery-sidecar notification template. Renderings are server-stamped, content-addressable artifacts; producing one does not by itself send a correspondence message. A subsequent `POST /api/v1/correspondence` may reference this rendering's URN via `renderingId` to commit it as a sent outbound message.

category.description: Template category resolved from the delivery sidecar (drives due-process validation for adverse-decision notices).

deliveryChannels.description: Delivery channels declared by the source template, projected through the closed `DeliveryChannelKind` enum.

missingVariables.description: Sorted, deduplicated names of required template variables that were not resolved. When non-empty the rendering is advisory only and MUST NOT be referenced by a subsequent `LogCorrespondenceMessageRequest`; the server returns `WOS-1422` if a caller attempts to do so.

items.description: Name of a template placeholder variable required by the template but not supplied or resolvable from case state.

rendered.description: Concatenated full-document rendering (sections joined with newlines) for clients that only need a single body string. Always present even when sections are empty post-condition (renders to the empty string).

renderedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the rendering was produced.

resolvedVariables.description: Sorted, deduplicated names of placeholder variables resolved during rendering. Closed shape — only variable names, never values.

items.description: Name of a template placeholder variable that was resolved during rendering.

sections.description: Ordered rendered sections after condition evaluation.

subject.description: Rendered subject line. Empty templates without subjects produce a server-supplied default (e.g., the template description); the field is always present so consumers do not branch on absence.

templateRef.description: Notification template key the renderer resolved.

workflowUrl.description: Workflow URI whose delivery sidecar supplied the template.

Counterfactual.description: Single counterfactual entry recorded in a Counterfactual-tier record (governance S6.4).

effect.description: Human-readable description of the counterfactual effect or non-effect.
examples: If reported income were $1,500 lower, applicant would qualify.
Applicant race did not factor into the eligibility decision.

factor.description: Short identifier or label for the factor.

polarity.description: Whether this counterfactual is positive (would change outcome) or negative (did not affect outcome).

CounterfactualPolarity.description: Counterfactual polarity (governance S6.4). `positive` records controllable factors that would change the outcome; `negative` records irrelevant factors that did not affect the outcome.

CounterfactualTierRecord.description: Counterfactual-tier provenance record (governance S6.4). Authoritative due-process layer recording what would change the outcome (positive) and which protected characteristics did not affect the outcome (negative). REQUIRED for transitions tagged `adverse-decision` in `rights-impacting` workflows.

actorRef.description: Actor URN responsible for the recorded counterfactual analysis.

definitionVersion.description: Version of the governing Kernel Document at append time.

event.description: Triggering event for the underlying transition.

factsRecordRef.description: URN of the Facts-tier record this counterfactual analyzes.

id.description: Stable URN for this provenance record.

negativeCounterfactuals.description: Irrelevant factors -- including protected characteristics -- that did NOT affect the outcome.

positiveCounterfactuals.description: Controllable factors that would change the outcome (governance S6.4).

processId.description: Workflow process URN this record belongs to.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the counterfactual was recorded.

CreateReportRunRequest.description: Request body for queuing a new report run. The input discriminator selects the report shape; the server rejects vendor-extension reportType literals at this version.

input.description: Closed parameterisation of the requested run.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Optional caller-supplied timeout ceiling in seconds for this run. Reports can scan up to `maxResults: 100000` rows, so a stuck runner must not stay `running` indefinitely; this ceiling bounds wall-clock execution. The server enforces a default of 3600 seconds when omitted; callers MAY raise it up to 86400 seconds (24 hours) -- the server applies a per-deployment ceiling and clamps higher requests downward without rejection. The resolved value is server-stamped on the resulting `ReportRun.maxDurationSeconds` so callers can see what was applied. Exceeding the ceiling at runtime transitions the run to `status == failed` with `failure.wosErrorCode == "WOS-1408"` (timeout exceeded).

CriterionResult.description: Single criterion check recorded in a Reasoning-tier record (governance S6.2).

criterion.description: Identifier or short label for the criterion that was checked.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail for the criterion result.

satisfied.description: True when the criterion was satisfied by the case facts.

CurrentRecordHistory.description: Exposes complete native history and explicitly validated accepted presentation evidence.

DashboardRangeOptionsTenantScope.description: Deployment tenant scope filter (ADR 0068 D-1.1 — Proposed). MUST agree with the `X-WOS-Tenant` header when both are present; the server rejects mismatches with `WOS-1422`.

DashboardSummary.description: Top-level dashboard rollup returned by `GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary`. Composes the three section rollups (`LifecycleStateRollup`, `SlaBreachSummary`, `RecentActivitySummary`) plus a single envelope-level `asOf` timestamp so consumers can decide whether to refresh. Per ADR 0082 D-7 the response is a cached `asOf`-stamped envelope rather than a cursor-paginated list — counts on append-only logs are best-effort and cached aggressively at the server.

asOf.description: UTC RFC 3339 envelope-level timestamp the summary was computed (ADR 0082 D-7). Section-level `asOf` fields MAY be earlier than this when the server caches sections at different cadences.

lifecycle.description: Closed map of case counts by lifecycle posture.

recentActivity.description: Count of recent governed events grouped by `RecentActivityEventClass`.

since.description: UTC RFC 3339 inclusive lower bound the rollup was computed against. Echoed from `DashboardRangeOptions.since` when supplied. Omitted when the server applied its default look-back window.

slaBreaches.description: Count and timestamp envelope of SLA breaches in the requested range.

tenantScope.description: Deployment tenant the rollup was computed for (ADR 0068 D-1.1 — Proposed). Single DNS label: lowercase ASCII letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, or hyphen, length 1 to 63. Echoed from the request when supplied; resolved from `X-WOS-Tenant` otherwise. Omitted only when the server has not yet adopted ADR 0068 scope-stamping.
