LoginKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension login credential family (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals: `password` (username + password); `webauthn` (FIDO2 / passkey assertion — required for respondent applicant identity per VISION §V respondent-side WebAuthn PRF binding for per-class encryption); `oidc-sso` (OpenID Connect single-sign-on hand-off, typical for staff via an external IdP). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix.

LoginRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. The `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header is REQUIRED per ADR 0082 D-16: login is externally side-effecting (it issues a token, opens a session, may emit an authentication-record event) and a network retry without idempotency would create duplicate sessions. The `kind` field is the discriminator for the credential payload's interpretation; per ADR 0082 D-12 it is closed-with-vendor-extension. Per ADR 0082 D-11 the credential fields are optional on the wire (presence depends on `kind`) but the server validates the kind/payload combination at receipt and rejects mismatches with `WOS-1422`. Note: the contract intentionally carries the credential payload as named-seam fields (`password`, `webauthnAssertion`, `oidcCode`) rather than a discriminated union body so the schema reads as a single closed object — adding a kind requires extending this object plus the `LoginKind` enum.

kind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension credential family. The accompanying credential field MUST match: `password` -> `username` + `password`; `webauthn` -> `webauthnAssertion`; `oidc-sso` -> `oidcCode`.

mfaChallengeId.description: Opaque token from a prior `LoginResponse.mfaChallenge` when this request continues an MFA flow. Omitted on the first request of a flow; required on the redemption request.

mfaResponse.description: Factor-specific response payload (TOTP code, SMS/email OTP, WebAuthn assertion, push approval token). Format depends on `MfaChallenge.kind`. Required when `mfaChallengeId` is present.

oidcCode.description: Reserved credential for a separately implemented server-brokered OIDC authorization flow. The current reference server rejects kind=oidc-sso on this login route. The supported browser integration direction uses maintained direct Authorization Code+PKCE and presents the resulting access token to the API; it does not post a bare code here. A broker would require its own reviewed expiring transaction, state/nonce/replay, PKCE and redirect checks.

password.description: Password for `kind == password` logins. Open string — never logged, never echoed back; the server hashes and discards. REQUIRED when `kind == password`.

requestedScope.description: Optional scope the client is requesting at login (Tenant / Organization / Workspace? / Environment per ADR 0082 D-9). When omitted the server resolves a default scope from the principal's primary membership. This is a requested selection, not a grant. Resolve it against the authenticated internal principal, authoritative membership grants and configured deployment; refuse unauthorized or unresolved selections.

username.description: Username for `kind == password` logins. Open string — opaque to the contract; the back-end resolves it to a principal. REQUIRED when `kind == password`.

webauthnAssertion.description: Base64URL-encoded WebAuthn / FIDO2 authenticator assertion (`AuthenticatorAssertionResponse`). REQUIRED when `kind == webauthn`. Open string with named seam — the server validates per the registered authenticator's public key.

LoginResponse.description: Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Carries the issued bearer token (when authentication succeeded), the active scope, expiry, and an optional `mfaChallenge` that the client must redeem before the response carries a token. When `mfaChallenge` is present, `accessToken` is omitted and the client redeems the challenge via a follow-up `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. When `mfaChallenge` is absent, the token is immediately usable.

accessToken.description: Opaque JWT bearer token used as the `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header value (ADR 0082 D-9). Omitted when `mfaChallenge` is present — the client MUST satisfy the challenge before receiving a token.

actorRef.description: URN of the principal the token authenticates. Present iff `accessToken` is present.

assuranceLevel.description: Authentication-assurance level attested by this session, derived from `LoginKind` and any satisfied MFA factor (ADR 0068 D-3.1 — Accepted).

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry timestamp for `accessToken`. Present iff `accessToken` is present.

mfaChallenge.description: Pending second-factor challenge. Present iff the deployment requires MFA and the first-factor credential succeeded but a second factor remains.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token redeemable at `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`. Omitted when the deployment does not issue refresh tokens (sandbox profiles) or when `mfaChallenge` is present.

scope.description: Active scope tuple at the time of token issuance (ADR 0082 D-9). Echoes `LoginRequest.requestedScope` when supplied; otherwise the server's resolved default.

tokenKind.description: Closed token-kind taxonomy. Always `bearer` at v1.

LogoutRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`. The `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header is OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — repeated logout calls are naturally idempotent on the visible state (the session is gone). Per ADR 0082 D-12 the `scope` enum is closed-no-extension because the choice is normative: vendor extensions would invite local-policy logout semantics that confuse audit trails.

scope.description: Closed logout scope. `this-session`: revoke only the bearer token presented on this request. `all-sessions`: revoke every active session for the bearer principal (the global-logout pattern that bumps `auth_epoch` per the WOS server auth contract — see `workspec-server/crates/wos-server/PARITY.md` ▎ Auth contract). Closed-no-extension by design: vendor-specific logout scopes would create audit ambiguity.

MarkNotificationReadRequest.description: Request body for marking a notification read.

readAt.description: Client-observed UTC RFC 3339 read timestamp. Server MAY replace with its own receipt time.

MessageChannel.description: Communication channel for the correspondence message. Reserved literals project the delivery sidecar `channel` enum (in-person, phone, mail, email, portal, fax). Vendor-prefixed extensions are namespaced per ADR 0082 D-12.

MessageDirection.description: Direction of the correspondence message relative to the agency. Closed projection of the delivery sidecar `direction` enum (https://wos-spec.org/schemas/delivery/1.0#/$defs/EntryTemplate/properties/direction).

MessageProducer.description: Producer family that authored or ingested the correspondence message. Reserved literals describe the canonical sources the WOS reference server emits or projects; vendor-prefixed extensions per ADR 0082 D-12.

MessageStatus.description: Delivery lifecycle of the correspondence message. `draft|queued|sent|delivered|failed|cancelled` apply to outbound messages; `received|acknowledged` apply to inbound messages. Closed enum with no extension seam; new states require a schema major bump.

MfaChallenge.description: Pending second-factor challenge returned in `LoginResponse` when the server requires a follow-up MFA step. The `challengeId` is opaque; the client redeems it via a follow-up `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with the same `Idempotency-Key` and the supplied factor's response; the contract for those follow-up shapes lives in a future amendment when the MFA back-and-forth surface ratifies. Today this resource serves as the discoverable seam declaring that an MFA step is REQUIRED.

challengeId.description: Opaque server-issued token identifying the pending MFA challenge. Single-use; expires per `expiresAt`.

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp at which the challenge expires (ADR 0069). Clients receiving an expired challenge MUST restart `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

hint.description: Optional hint displayed to the actor (for example a redacted email or phone number for `email-otp` / `sms-otp` factors). Open prose — UX concern.

kind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension second-factor family the client must satisfy.

MfaChallengeKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension second-factor challenge family (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals: `totp` (RFC 6238 time-based OTP); `webauthn` (FIDO2 / passkey assertion as a second factor when the primary credential is `password`); `sms-otp` (SMS one-time code); `email-otp` (email one-time code); `push` (out-of-band push approval). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix. Note: `sms-otp` is recorded as the lowest-assurance literal the vocabulary exposes; high-assurance deployments SHOULD prefer `webauthn` or `totp`.

MilestoneId.description: Stable milestone identifier from the workflow document (Kernel S4 milestones; kernel:661-672). Sorted lexicographically when surfaced as a set.

NarrativeTierRecord.description: Narrative-tier provenance record (AI integration S13). Non-authoritative model-generated explanation. MUST carry `authoritative: false`. A conformant implementation MUST NOT treat narrative content as dispositive in adjudicative, audit, or due-process contexts (S13.2).

actorRef.description: Agent URN that generated the narrative.

authoritative.description: MUST be `false`. Explicitly marks this content as non-authoritative (S13.2).

confidenceReport.description: Per-output confidence record for the model that generated this narrative (ai-integration.md §7.1 — "every agent output MUST be accompanied by a ConfidenceReport"; the narrative IS an agent output even though it is non-authoritative). Surfaced so consumers can gate narrative display on confidence (low-confidence narratives can be suppressed or annotated).

definitionVersion.description: Version of the governing Kernel Document at append time.

event.description: Triggering event for the underlying transition.

factsRecordRef.description: URN of the Facts-tier record this narrative explains.

id.description: Stable URN for this provenance record.

modelIdentifier.description: Identifier of the model that generated this narrative.

modelVersion.description: Version of the model that generated this narrative.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this record belongs to.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the narrative was generated.

NoticeSentRecord.description: Typed runtime payload appended to `FactsTierRecord` when the corresponding event literal is present (governance §3.2, workflow-governance.md:127). The byte-deterministic adverse-decision notice obligation requires that an applicant can retrieve the notice that was actually sent and verify hash equality against the Trellis-anchored copy. The four fields here are the load-bearing minimum: kind discriminator, content hash, recipient, and delivery timestamp. The full rendered notice body lives behind a `correspondenceRenderingRef` URN (claim-check pattern — D-3 subresource decomposition).

appealDeadline.description: Optional RFC 3339 appeal-window deadline derived deterministically from policy + transition-firing timestamp + business calendar. Present when the notice kind carries appeal rights (typically `adverseDecisionNotice`).

correspondenceRenderingRef.description: Optional URN of the rendered notice content (correspondence.schema.json `CorrespondenceRendering`). Claim-check pointer to the full prose; not inlined here to keep Facts-tier records small.

deliveryTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the notice was delivered (or when delivery was attempted for asynchronous channels). The transition-firing timestamp is captured separately on the parent `FactsTierRecord.timestamp`.

noticeKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension notice taxonomy mirroring the delivery-sidecar `NotificationTemplate.category` (correspondence.schema.json `RenderingCategory`). Reserved literals are normative due-process classifiers; vendor-extension form `x-<agency>-<category>` is permitted only when no reserved literal applies.

recipientActorRef.description: Actor URN of the notice recipient (typically the applicant, but may be a delegated representative or guardian per governance §11).

snapshotSha256.description: JCS-canonical SHA-256 hex digest of the notice's machine-readable artifact. Identical to the Facts-tier `caseFileSnapshot.sha256` for the determination that produced the notice (workflow-governance.md:127 byte-determinism requirement); applicants verify hash equality against the Trellis-anchored notice copy.

templateRef.description: Optional URN of the notification template used to render the notice (delivery-sidecar `NotificationTemplate`). Surfaced for audit traceability — the template + snapshot + transition-firing timestamp produce byte-identical notice bytes.

Notification.description: Notification feed item for a single principal within a scoped WOS workspace. The `bundle-completed` variant carries a REQUIRED `bundleId`; every other variant carries `bundleId` optionally. The two variants are split as a closed-discriminated `oneOf` over `type` (PLN-0403 path (a) — typify cannot express `if`/`then`/`else`; the structural discriminator carries the same contract).

NotificationAction.description: Primary action exposed by a notification.

href.description: Relative or absolute URI for external-url actions.

kind.description: Closed action family available from this notification.

resourceId.description: Target WOS resource for resource-opening actions.

NotificationActionKind.description: Closed action family available from a notification.

NotificationFeedOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Notification items in this page.

NotificationSeverity.description: User-facing urgency level for ordering and presentation.

NotificationSource.description: Producer family that emitted or projected this notification.

NotificationStatus.description: Current user-specific read lifecycle for the notification.

OutcomeCode.description: Machine-readable terminal-outcome marker populated only when `lifecycleState == completed` (Kernel S6 final-state `outcomeCode`). Identifier-shaped so downstream systems can branch on completion semantics without parsing state names. Absent on non-completed cases.

OverrideRecord.description: Typed runtime payload appended to `FactsTierRecord` when the corresponding event literal is present (governance §7.3, workflow-governance.md:400-407). Mirrors the kernel `OverrideRecord` $def (`wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/OverrideRecord`); the API projection uses `workflowProcessRef` (URN per ADR 0082 D-4) rather than the kernel TypeID. Three required structured fields correspond to the three OverrideAuthority policy switches: `requireStructuredRationale → rationale`, `requireAuthorityVerification → authorityVerification`, `requireSupportingEvidence → supportingEvidence`. The audit query `eventFilter: ["overrideRecorded"]` returns `FactsTierRecord` envelopes carrying this payload in `overrideRecord`.

authorityVerification.description: Record of how the overriding actor's authority was verified (governance §7.3 item 2). Captures who verified, when, and against which delegation/policy reference. Processors that verify automatically (e.g., role lookup) MUST still populate this so the audit trail is complete.

actorRef.description: Actor URN that performed the override (D-9).

delegationRef.description: Optional URN of the delegation grant that authorized this override (governance §11).

verifiedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the authority was verified.

overriddenRecordRef.description: URN of the prior provenance record being overridden (e.g., the determination `stateTransition` whose outcome is being reversed).

rationale.description: Structured human-readable rationale explaining the basis for the override. The audit trail always carries a one-line `summary`; agencies MAY cite regulatory authorities under `regulatoryCitations`.

regulatoryCitations.description: Optional citations to regulatory authorities, statutes, or policies that support the override. Free-form citation strings.

summary.description: One-line human-readable explanation of why the override was issued. Surfaced in audit reports and adverse-decision notices.

supportingEvidence.description: Evidence references supporting the override (governance §7.3 item 3). At least one entry MUST be present when the OverrideAuthority policy switch `requireSupportingEvidence` is true; conformant servers always populate it.

PolicySnapshotSource.description: Canonically hashed policy/config source included in the case export fence.

digest.description: Canonical JSON hash of the source material at fence acquisition.

sourceRef.description: Stable reference to the hashed material (process URN, workflow URL@version, or deployment-scoped fragment ref).

versionBinding.description: How `sourceRef` is bound when recomputing the per-source digest.

PolicySnapshotSourceKind.description: Closed policy-material family emitted by the reference server's fence builder. New kinds require a schema minor bump — vendor extensions belong on bundle manifests, not the source fence.

PolicySnapshotVersionBinding.description: Closed version-binding literal describing how `sourceRef` is interpreted when recomputing digests.

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details response with stack-generic machine code and optional context.

detail.description: Human-readable detail specific to this occurrence.
examples: No workflow process exists for the requested identifier.

instance.description: URI reference for the affected resource when a single resource caused the problem.

status.description: HTTP status code generated by the server for this problem.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of this problem type.

type.description: Dereferenceable URI for the documented error type.

ProcessFenceHighWater.description: Per-process high-water marker for the case export fence.

definitionUrl.description: Workflow definition URL the process instance was started from.

definitionVersion.description: Pinned workflow definition version at fence acquisition.

eventCount.description: Count of provenance events emitted by this process at fence acquisition.

latestEvent.description: Last process-emitted event observed at fence acquisition. Absent when the process has no events.

processId.description: Workflow process URN bound to the case ledger.

status.description: Workflow process lifecycle status at fence acquisition.

ProcessPathId.description: Path parameter accepted by workflow-process routes. Deployments MAY accept either the full WOS process URN (`urn:wos:<tenant>_process_<ulid>`) or the bare TypeID (`<tenant>_process_<ulid>`) while response bodies always carry the full `WosResourceUrn`.

ProvenanceListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page (ADR 0082 D-7). Cursor pagination still applies on top of the AND-composed filter set; cursors are opaque, single-use within the issuing deploy.

ProvenanceListOptionsTier.description: Optional tier filter. When omitted, all tiers are returned.

ProvenanceRecord.description: Tier-discriminated provenance record union (ADR 0082 D-5). The four tiers correspond to kernel Facts (S8), governance Reasoning (S6.2) and Counterfactual (S6.4), and AI integration Narrative (S13). The legacy single-envelope shape with four optional tier blocks (current `case-portal` `ProvenanceRecord`) is structurally inexpressible: every variant requires its own `tier` const literal and tier-specific fields are non-optional within their variant.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Tier-discriminated provenance records in this page.

ProvenanceTimeRange.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 time-range filter for `ProvenanceListOptions` (ADR 0069 wire format). Bounds the query to records whose `timestamp` falls within `[since, until]`. Mirrors the `AuditQueryRequest.timeRange` shape from `audit.schema.json` so cross-case audit and per-case provenance share the same filter contract.

since.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 lower bound for the provenance window. Records with `timestamp >= since` are eligible.

until.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 upper bound for the provenance window. Records with `timestamp <= until` are eligible.

QuorumReductionRecord.description: Typed public payload for explicit quorum-reduction provenance. Governance §S4.9 forbids silent quorum reduction; any reduction is a policy transition with a provenance-backed before/after record.

examples.reason: one quorum member unavailable under declared emergency operations

actorRef.description: Actor URN that authorized the quorum reduction.

authorityBasis.description: Policy, legal instrument, or supervisor authority authorizing the reduction.

delegationRef.description: Delegation resource URN whose quorum requirement changed.

newRequiredCount.description: New quorum count after the explicit reduction.

priorRequiredCount.description: Prior quorum count before the explicit reduction.

reason.description: Human-readable operational reason for the reduction.

ReasoningTierRecord.description: Reasoning-tier provenance record (governance S6.2). Authoritative interpretive layer recording how a decision was reached: which rules applied, which evidence was consulted, which criteria were checked. REQUIRED for transitions tagged `determination`.

actorRef.description: Actor URN responsible for the recorded reasoning.

assertionGates.description: Per-gate assertion results that fired during this reasoning step (governance §5.4 + §5.5; workflow-governance.md:293-309). Empty when the reasoning record did not run through a validation pipeline; populated when one or more gates evaluated. The pipeline's risk profile is determined by the weakest gate that passed (workflow-governance.md:309) — auditors read this array directly.

confidenceReport.description: Per-output confidence record (ai-integration.md §7.1). Present iff an agent produced the output this reasoning record interprets; absent for human-only reasoning steps.

decisionRequirements.description: Declaration of required inputs and applicable rules (governance S6.3).

definitionVersion.description: Version of the governing Kernel Document at append time.

event.description: Triggering event for the underlying transition.

evidenceConsulted.description: Evidence references examined during this decision.

factsRecordRef.description: URN of the Facts-tier record this reasoning interprets.

id.description: Stable URN for this provenance record.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this record belongs to.

rulesApplied.description: Rules applied in this decision, with authority citations.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the reasoning was recorded.

ReceiptOperation.description: Existing command purposes that can own a protected person receipt.

RecentActivityEventClass.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension event-class taxonomy (ADR 0082 D-12) for `RecentActivitySummary`. Reserved literals project the WOS event families a dashboard consumer typically wants to count: case-lifecycle (`case-created | case-completed | case-terminated`), task-lifecycle (`task-created | task-submitted | task-dismissed | task-expired`), review-protocol (`review-cleared | review-flagged`; governance S4), holds (`hold-engaged | hold-released`; governance S12), delegation (`delegation-granted | delegation-revoked`; governance S11), correspondence (`correspondence-sent | correspondence-received`). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix — vendor-specific event classes do not break compatibility.

RecentActivityEventCount.description: Single (event-class, count) pair in a `RecentActivitySummary`. The array-of-pairs shape (rather than `additionalProperties: true` keyed by event class) preserves the closed-with-vendor-extension `RecentActivityEventClass` taxonomy on the wire.

count.description: Number of events of this class observed in the requested range, computed as of `RecentActivitySummary.asOf`. Best-effort per ADR 0082 D-7.

RecentActivitySummary.description: Counts of recent governed events grouped by `RecentActivityEventClass`, returned by `GET /api/v1/dashboard/recent-activity` and embedded in `DashboardSummary.recentActivity`. Per ADR 0082 D-7 the response is a cached `asOf`-stamped envelope rather than a cursor-paginated list — the dashboard surface is count-style.

asOf.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp the summary was computed.

items.description: One `RecentActivityEventCount` per event class observed in the requested range. Event classes with zero observations MAY be omitted at server discretion.

RefreshRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`. The `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header is OPTIONAL — refresh is naturally idempotent on `(refreshToken)` for the deployment retention window: a repeat request returns the same fresh `accessToken`/`refreshToken` pair. The contract intentionally keeps the refresh token in the body (not a header or a cookie) so it survives mTLS-style transports without depending on browser context.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token previously issued by `LoginResponse.refreshToken` or a prior `RefreshResponse.refreshToken`. Single-use within the deployment retention window; the server SHOULD rotate the refresh token on each redemption.

RefreshResponse.description: Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`. Issues a fresh access token and (typically) a rotated refresh token. The active scope is echoed so clients can confirm the session continues at the expected scope.

accessToken.description: Fresh JWT bearer token replacing the prior `accessToken`.

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry timestamp for the new `accessToken`.

refreshToken.description: Rotated refresh token replacing the one redeemed by this request. Omitted when the deployment configuration uses non-rotating refresh tokens.

scope.description: Active scope tuple for the refreshed session (ADR 0082 D-9). MUST equal the redeemed token's prior scope; refresh does NOT swap scope.

tokenKind.description: Closed token-kind taxonomy. Always `bearer` at v1.

RenderCorrespondenceRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/correspondence/renderings`. Renders an outbound delivery-sidecar notification template with placeholder substitution against the supplied closed-shape variable set. Folds in the legacy `POST /api/v1/notifications/{workflowUrl}/render` route per ADR 0082 D-15 step 2.

processId.description: Optional workflow process URN. When present the server MAY enrich rendering variables from case state per the workflow's delivery sidecar.

templateRef.description: Notification template key from the delivery sidecar's `notifications.templates`.

variables.description: Caller-supplied rendering variables. Closed item shape; no `Record<string, unknown>` escape hatch.

workflowUrl.description: Workflow URI used to resolve the delivery sidecar's `notifications.templates` map.

RenderedSection.description: Rendered section of a correspondence message. Mirrors the section ordering of the source delivery template after condition evaluation.

body.description: Rendered section body with placeholders substituted.
examples: Your application for SNAP has been denied.

contentType.description: Closed content-type taxonomy projected from the delivery template `TemplateSection.contentType` (https://wos-spec.org/schemas/delivery/1.0#/$defs/TemplateSection/properties/contentType).

id.description: Source section identifier from the delivery template.

title.description: Optional section heading rendered above the body.

RenderingCategory.description: Notification template category resolved during rendering. Closed projection of the delivery sidecar `NotificationTemplate.category` enum (https://wos-spec.org/schemas/delivery/1.0#/$defs/NotificationTemplate/properties/category).

x-lm.intent: Classifies the template by governance event type to enforce category-specific requirements

RenderingVariable.description: Single named variable supplied to the renderer. Closed shape with no `Record<string, unknown>` escape hatch.

name.description: Variable name matched against `{{name}}` placeholders in the resolved template. Constrained identifier shape to keep the rendering surface narrow.

value.description: Variable value. Closed JSON-primitive set; nested objects are not expressible by design.

RenderingVariableValue.description: Permitted JSON-primitive value types for a rendering variable: string, number, integer, boolean, null, or array of strings. Nested objects are intentionally forbidden so callers cannot smuggle arbitrary case-state shapes through the rendering context.

oneOf.description: String variable value substituted verbatim into the rendered template.
Numeric variable value (floating-point). Renderers convert to canonical decimal form.
Integer variable value. Renderers convert to canonical decimal form.
Boolean variable value. Renderers emit `true` or `false` unless the template formats explicitly.

oneOf.$comment: why-null: explicit null is a legitimate variable value distinct from absence; an absent variable raises `missingVariables`, while null renders to the empty string.
oneOf.description: Explicit null variable value. Renders to the empty string; distinct from omitting the variable entirely.
Multi-value string variable (e.g., reason codes). Renderers join elements per template formatting.

items.description: String element of a multi-value variable (e.g., reason codes).

ReportFailure.description: Failure detail attached to a report run when status is failed.

wosErrorCode.description: Stable WOS error code from the public error registry that classifies this failure.

ReportInput.description: Closed discriminated union over reportType. Each reserved reportType binds a fixed input shape; vendor-extension reportType literals are not accepted by this contract version because the input shape would be unspecified (ADR 0082 D-15 step 2 amendment retains the closed-on-input posture even as the wire `ReportType` enum admits vendor extensions for forward-compat URN minting).

ReportRow.description: Closed discriminated union over reportType. Each reserved reportType binds a fixed row shape; the row reportType MUST match the parent run reportType.

ReportRowPage.description: Cursor-paginated row page for a succeeded report run. The runId and reportType anchor every row to a single run.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another row page is available from the server.

items.description: Row items in this page; each row's reportType MUST match the page reportType.

reportType.description: Report-type literal shared by every row in this page.

runId.description: Report-run URN this page belongs to.

ReportRun.description: A WOS report run resource. The run envelope is reportType-agnostic; reportType variation is confined to the input and rows discriminated unions.

completedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the run reached a terminal status. Omitted while pending or running.

failure.description: Failure detail when status is failed. Omitted otherwise.

id.description: Stable public URN for this report run.

input.description: Closed parameterisation of the run discriminated by reportType.

maxDurationSeconds.description: REQUIRED resolved timeout ceiling in seconds applied to this run. Server-stamped at queue time so callers can see what was applied: equals `CreateReportRunRequest.maxDurationSeconds` when supplied (clamped to the per-deployment ceiling), otherwise the server default (3600 seconds). Exceeding this ceiling at runtime transitions the run to `status == failed` with `failure.wosErrorCode == "WOS-1408"` and the runner records a `reportTimedOut` Facts-tier provenance literal with typed timeout payload.

queuedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the run was accepted onto the queue.

reportType.description: Closed report-type taxonomy literal. MUST equal input.reportType and (when rows are present) rows[*].reportType.

rowCount.description: Total result-row count when status is succeeded. Omitted otherwise.

startedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when execution began. Omitted while pending.

status.description: Current lifecycle status.

ReportRunListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page.

ReportRunPage.description: Cursor-paginated report-run page. Runs are returned newest-first by queuedAt.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Report-run items in this page.

ReportStatus.description: Lifecycle status for a report run. Closed enum: pending (queued, not yet started), running (executing), succeeded (completed with rows), failed (terminated with error), cancelled (caller cancelled before completion).

ReportTimedOutRecord.description: Typed public payload for `reportTimedOut`. Records that a report run exceeded its server-enforced wall-clock ceiling and failed with WOS-1408.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Resolved timeout ceiling applied to the run.

reportRunRef.description: Report-run resource URN that timed out.

wosErrorCode.description: Canonical API error code for timeout exceeded.

ReportType.description: Closed report-type taxonomy with vendor-prefixed extension literals. Each reserved literal binds a fixed input shape and a fixed row shape; the report-run schema projects governance, AI oversight, equity, and operational concerns into named report types rather than an open string. Vendor-extension literals are reserved at the wire layer per ADR 0082 D-15 step 2 amendment but are NOT accepted by the v1 input/row contract — extension reports ship their own `schemas/api/<resource>.schema.json` rather than overloading this one.

ResponseValue.description: Response payload submitted by the actor, carried as an opaque JSON value (typically an object). The structural contract for this value is the workflow's task contract (Kernel S7.2 + governance S10), resolved via the task's `contractRef`, `definitionUrl`, and `definitionVersion`. The reference server validates the payload against the resolved contract at submission time; this contract treats the value as opaque-shaped. The wire posture matches `CaseStateMutation.previousValue` / `newValue` and `EvaluationResult.mutations[].newValue` — any JSON value, validated downstream against the workflow.

ReviewProtocolKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension review-protocol classification (governance §4.1 Protocol Definitions, §4.2 Protocol Combination; workflow-governance.md:248-260). Reserved literals: `independentFirst` (the reviewer's independent assessment MUST be recorded before any agent/upstream recommendation is accessible — §4.2 enforcement obligation); `considerOpposite` (the reviewer is required to consider the opposite outcome before settling); `calibratedConfidence` (the reviewer's confidence is calibrated against historical accuracy); `dualBlind` (two independent reviewers without cross-visibility); `unassisted` (the reviewer is not exposed to upstream recommendations). Vendor extensions MUST use an `^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` prefix per ADR 0082 D-12.

ReviewerEngagementInput.description: Input parameters for the reviewer-engagement report. Computes per-reviewer agreement rates and review depth signals (drift-monitor agreement-rate floor, AI Integration §13).

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the reviewer-engagement input variant.

reviewerId.description: Optional reviewer actor reference to restrict the report to a single reviewer.

timeRange.description: UTC time window over which engagement metrics are computed.

workflowUrl.description: Author-time workflow URL to scope the report to. Omit to span all visible workflows.

ReviewerEngagementRow.description: Per-reviewer result row for the reviewer-engagement report.

agreementRate.description: Rate at which the reviewer agreed with agent recommendations in [0,1].

averageReviewSeconds.description: Mean time spent per review in seconds.

engagementFlagged.description: True when agreementRate exceeded the drift-monitor agreement-rate floor configured for the workflow.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the reviewer-engagement row variant.

reviewerId.description: Reviewer actor reference this row is attributed to.

reviewsCount.description: Number of reviews completed within the window.

RuleReference.description: Reference to an authoritative rule applied in a decision. Mirrors `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/RuleReference` (governance S6.2). Inlined at the API layer so codegen does not need a cross-schema resolver; structurally aligned so the API projection is byte-compatible with the kernel definition.

citation.description: Formal citation to the source document.

examples: Annual renewal of eligibility required for continued benefit receipt.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier (statute section, regulation paragraph, policy ID).

ScopeContext.description: Current scope context for the bearer token, returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/scope`. Carries the scope tuple per VISION §V and ADR 0082 D-9: Tenant -> Organization -> Workspace -> Environment. The shape reuses `ActorScope` from `actor.schema.json` so the wire form is canonical; per ADR 0082 D-14 inline redefinition would be a contract bug. The `actorRef` field identifies the principal the token authenticates; consumers that need the principal class can read it from the URN's principal-class segment without a second round-trip.

actorRef.description: URN of the principal authenticated by the bearer token.

assuranceLevel.description: Authentication-assurance level the bearer token attests.

loginKind.description: Credential family used to obtain the original session. Useful for downstream policy that gates rights-impacting actions on `webauthn`-authenticated sessions.

mfaSatisfied.description: True when the bearer token's session has satisfied a second-factor challenge. Single-factor sessions (legacy / sandbox deployments) MAY return false.

scope.description: Actual granted public ActorScope membership resolved for the authenticated internal principal and selected deployment. Never synthesize demo/default membership or echo token/request claims as permissions. The public membership view is explicitly mapped to, and distinct from, the internal deployment/storage scope.

ScopeSwapRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/scope-swap`. The `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header is REQUIRED per ADR 0082 D-16: scope-swap is externally side-effecting (it emits a governance audit event and issues a fresh token bound to the new scope). Per ADR 0068 D-2 (Accepted) the case scope bundle `(Tenant, DefinitionId, KernelId, LedgerId)` is immutable for the case lifetime; this endpoint swaps the *session's* scope for actors who hold authority across multiple Organization / Workspace / Environment scopes within a tenant. Cross-tenant swaps are rejected per ADR 0068 D-1 (cross-tenant reads are impossible by construction).

targetScope.description: Target scope tuple the session swaps to (Tenant -> Organization -> Workspace? -> Environment per ADR 0082 D-9). The server validates per-tenant authorization (ADR 0068 D-3 — authority is per-tenant; cross-tenant swaps are rejected with `WOS-1403`). The `tenant` field MUST equal the bearer token's current tenant; mismatches are rejected with `WOS-1403`. This is a requested selection, not a grant. Resolve it against the authenticated internal principal, authoritative membership grants and configured deployment; refuse unauthorized or unresolved selections.

Sha256PrefixedDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest with `sha256:` prefix per `stack-common-hash` canonical JSON hashing.

ShadowModeDivergenceRecord.description: Typed public payload for `shadowModeDivergence`. Records a material divergence between a shadow-mode agent output and its configured baseline.

examples.summary: Shadow agent recommended approval while the baseline reviewer denied.

baseline.description: Configured baseline the shadow output was compared against, such as human or a production model identifier.

divergenceType.description: Closed classifier for the observed divergence.

magnitude.description: Normalized divergence magnitude, when the comparison method yields one.

severity.description: Operational severity assigned to the divergence.

SlaBreachSummary.description: Counted SLA breaches across cases in the requested range, returned by `GET /api/v1/dashboard/sla-breaches` and embedded in `DashboardSummary.slaBreaches`. SLA breach semantics (governance S10.3, S10.4) are workflow-defined; the dashboard projects the count and the timestamp envelope of breach occurrences. Per ADR 0082 D-7 the response is a cached `asOf`-stamped envelope, not a list.

count.description: Total SLA breach occurrences in the requested range. Best-effort per ADR 0082 D-7; counts on append-only logs are cached, not transactionally consistent.

earliestBreachAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the earliest SLA breach in the requested range. Omitted when `count` is zero.

latestBreachAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest SLA breach in the requested range. Omitted when `count` is zero.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the SLA performance row variant.

withinSlaCount.description: Tasks completed within their declared SLA.

actorRef.description: Actor associated with this notification when the projection has a single responsible actor.

bundleId.description: Bundle resource associated with this notification when applicable. Typically absent on non-bundle event families; the `bundle-completed` arm (`BundleCompletedNotification`) makes it REQUIRED.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the notification was created.

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry timestamp or the literal never for non-expiring notifications.

id.description: Stable public URN for this notification.

processId.description: Workflow process resource associated with this notification when applicable.

readAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the user marked the notification read. Omitted while unread.

status.description: Current user-specific read lifecycle.

taskId.description: Task resource associated with this notification when applicable.

type.description: Closed reserved-event-family literal (excluding `bundle-completed`) or the vendor extension form.

StandardNotificationType.description: Closed reserved set of `NotificationType` literals with `bundle-completed` excluded (that literal is carried by `BundleCompletedNotification` only) plus the vendor extension pattern. Adding a new reserved literal requires editing both `NotificationType` (the closed-family enumeration that consumers may inspect) and this arm-side enum.

StartApplicationRequest.description: Starts an application case for a Source-owned draft.

draftRef.description: The draft reference; the request's `Idempotency-Key` must equal it.

Task.description: Full public task projection (ADR 0082 D-3). Adds contract binding, draft state, and validation outcome to the `TaskListItem` core. The kernel runtime artifact `wos-process.schema.json#/$defs/ActiveTask` is prior art; this is greenfield (ADR 0082 D-15) so the projection diverges intentionally: identifiers are URNs (D-4), `status` is the closed user-facing taxonomy (not the kernel `created|assigned|claimed|...` set), and the form-rendering `context` block is not surfaced (clients fetch the form via `definitionUrl`/`definitionVersion`).

assignedActor.description: Actor URN currently responsible for this task. Updated on delegation or escalation.

assignmentRoles.description: Five-role task-assignment projection (governance §7.2 + §10.2; workflow-governance.md:502-514). Surfaces `excludedOwner`/`requiredOwner`/`eligiblePool`/`currentAssignee`/`delegatedFrom`/`businessAdministrator` so a staff portal can render the full role table without re-deriving from delegation graphs. Absent when the task carries no role declarations beyond the top-level `assignedActor`/`delegatedFrom` fields (which mirror `currentAssignee`/`delegatedFrom` on this projection).

caseLedgerId.description: Governed case ledger URN associated with this task's process, when available.

contractRef.description: Key into the Workflow Document's `contracts` map identifying which contract governs this task body (Kernel S7.2). REQUIRED when `binding` is `formspec` or `jsonSchema`.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task was created.

deadlines.description: Full set of named SLA / statutory / internal deadlines on this task (governance §10.4.1; workflow-governance.md:548-560). Carries `firstResponse` and `fullResolution` for multi-SLA workflows plus any statutory windows. Empty when the workflow declares no deadlines on this task pattern.

definitionUrl.description: Form or contract definition URL pinned at task creation. REQUIRED when `binding` is `formspec` or `jsonSchema`. Clients render the body by resolving this URL together with `definitionVersion`.

definitionVersion.description: Form or contract definition version pinned at task creation. REQUIRED when `binding` is `formspec` or `jsonSchema`.

delegatedFrom.description: Actor URN that delegated this task to the current `assignedActor`. Omitted when the task was directly assigned.

description.description: Optional longer-form task description for actor context.

draftResponse.description: Most recent draft response saved via `POST /tasks/{id}/draft`. Present only when `status == drafted`.

draftedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the draft was last saved. Present only when `status == drafted`.

expiresAt.description: Immutable expiry copied from the actual native timer at task creation. Fresh drafts and responses refuse at or after this instant; committed replay remains available. Required together with expiresWithTimer (Kernel §13.2.1).

expiresWithTimer.description: Original native timer identifier supplying expiresAt. Forwarded unchanged; later timer cancellation or replacement does not change the copied task lifetime (Kernel §13.2.1).

id.description: Stable public URN for this task.

lastValidationOutcome.description: Most recent validation outcome for the draft or submitted response.

mustCompleteBeforeContinuationEnds.description: When true, this task MUST be completed before the case's `continuationOfServicesEndsAt` window closes (governance §3.6 cross-cut; workflow-governance.md:154-158). Applicant- and staff-facing UIs surface this flag to prioritize work that gates continued service delivery during an appeal window. Absent on tasks unrelated to the continuation policy.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this task belongs to.

reviewProtocol.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension review-protocol classification (governance §4.1-§4.2; workflow-governance.md:248-260). Surfaces the `independentFirst` / `considerOpposite` / `calibratedConfidence` / `dualBlind` / `unassisted` posture so a staff portal can lock recommendation visibility until the reviewer's independent assessment is recorded. Present iff `kind == review` and the workflow declares a review protocol on this task pattern.

status.description: Closed user-facing task lifecycle posture.

taskRevision.description: Opaque stored revision of the current task, when available. Send this exact value when an operation requires an expected task revision.

updatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task projection was last refreshed.

workflowUrl.description: Absolute URI of the governing Workflow Document.

TaskBinding.description: Closed contract-binding kind for the task body (Kernel S7.2). Byte-aligned mirror of the kernel `ActiveTask.binding` enum at `wos-process.schema.json#/$defs/ActiveTask/properties/binding` (ADR 0082 D-13 gate 6). `formspec` is rendered by Formspec; `jsonSchema` is a generic JSON-Schema-validated payload; `freeform` is a structured task with no machine-validated payload (typical of dismissals or simple acknowledgements). Closed-no-extension at this layer; if a deployment needs new bindings, the kernel grows them and the API mirror tracks.

TaskDeadline.description: Single named SLA window on a task (governance §10.4.1 multi-SLA authoring; workflow-governance.md:548-560 — `slaDefinitions: array<SlaDefinition>`). The current single-valued `deadline` field captures only one of `firstResponse` / `fullResolution` / statutory windows; this typed sub-shape exposes the full set so the applicant sees both clocks and the staff portal prioritizes by which window is closer to breach.

at.description: UTC RFC 3339 absolute deadline timestamp, or the literal `never` (ADR 0082 D-10 sentinel pattern). The window expires at this instant; warning notifications fire at workflow-declared lead-time before.

id.description: Optional stable identifier matching the workflow's `slaDefinitions[].id` (governance §10.4.1). Lets clients correlate a deadline with the named window it implements (`firstResponse`, `fullResolution`).

kind.description: Closed-no-extension deadline classification. `sla` is a service-level agreement window; `statutory` is a legally-binding regulatory window (typically `enforcing` severity); `internal` is an organizational target (typically `advisory`). Closed by design — adding a new kind requires a schema major bump.

severity.description: Closed-no-extension severity classification. `advisory` deadlines surface to UI but do not by themselves trigger escalation; `enforcing` deadlines fire the workflow's breach-policy escalation chain on expiry (governance §10.3 + §10.4 escalation chains).

TaskDismissal.description: Reason-only dismissal request. Requires a singular readable nonblank Idempotency-Key header, preserved exactly. Records actual acting-actor provenance and leaves the governed task resumable (Kernel §13.4). Matching task/actor/token/reason replay returns the original committed provenance reference and timestamp. Changed reason under the same key or a new token for the same task/actor/reason conflicts without another effect. Current host admission and output-read checks remain required. The runtime does not invoke the presenter; delivery is separately authorized.

reason.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension dismissal rationale. Vendor extensions MUST use an `x-` prefix.

TaskDraft.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/draft`. The endpoint saves a partial response without committing it; repeated drafts overwrite the prior draft. Idempotent on `(taskId, definitionUrl, definitionVersion, response)` — repeated identical drafts return the same drafted-state representation. The server runs the workflow's validation pipeline against the draft and returns the validation outcome on the resulting `Task` projection.

definitionUrl.description: Form or contract definition URL the draft was authored against. MUST match the task's pinned `definitionUrl`; mismatches are rejected with `WOS-1409`.

definitionVersion.description: Form or contract definition version. MUST match the task's pinned `definitionVersion`.

draftedAt.description: Optional client-observed UTC RFC 3339 timestamp. The server MAY replace with its own receipt time.

response.description: Partial response payload conforming to the task's contract.

TaskKind.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension task family (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals: `intake` (initial application capture); `review` (governance review-protocol step); `determination` (rights-impacting decision per Kernel S9.2 / governance S6); `signature` (signature-profile signer step); `correspondence-response` (reply to inbound correspondence); `hold-resolution` (action that resumes a typed hold per governance S12); `escalation` (manual escalation step); `verification` (independent confirmation of a prior mutation, see `verificationLevel` in `instance.schema.json`). Vendor extensions MUST use an `x-` prefix.

TaskListItem.description: Lightweight task projection for list views (ADR 0082 D-3). Carries identity, classification, status, deadline, and binding metadata — enough to drive an inbox-style list without forcing the heavier `Task` body. The full `Task` shape is fetched per row on detail navigation.

assignedActor.description: Actor URN currently responsible for this task. Updated on delegation or escalation.

caseLedgerId.description: Governed case ledger URN associated with this task's process, when available.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task was created.

deadline.description: UTC RFC 3339 deadline by which the actor SHOULD submit the response before SLA breach (governance S10.3).

expiresAt.description: Immutable expiry copied from the actual native timer at task creation. Fresh drafts and responses refuse at or after this instant; committed replay remains available. Required together with expiresWithTimer (Kernel §13.2.1).

expiresWithTimer.description: Original native timer identifier supplying expiresAt. Forwarded unchanged; later timer cancellation or replacement does not change the copied task lifetime (Kernel §13.2.1).

id.description: Stable public URN for this task.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this task belongs to.

status.description: Closed user-facing task lifecycle posture.

taskRevision.description: Opaque stored revision of the current task, when available. Send this exact value when an operation requires an expected task revision.

updatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the task projection was last refreshed.

workflowUrl.description: Absolute URI of the governing Workflow Document.

TaskListOptionsCursor.description: Opaque resume token returned by the previous page (ADR 0082 D-7).

TaskListOptionsTaskRef.description: Exact authored task reference from the authorized native task facts.task_ref.

TaskListOptionsWorkflowVersion.description: Exact governing workflow version from the process definition_version, independent of the task's form or contract definitionVersion.

TaskOutcomeEvent.description: Wire shape of a task state change emitted to subscribed observers (notifications domain, server-side projections). Carries the task URN, the new posture, the actor responsible, and the outcome literal — enough for downstream projections to update without re-fetching the task. The structurally-identical `Task` resource is also retrievable; this event is the projection seam for incremental consumers.

actorRef.description: Actor URN responsible for this state change. Omitted only for system-driven outcomes (`expired`).

newStatus.description: Closed user-facing status the task entered as a result of this event.

occurredAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the state change took effect server-side.

outcome.description: Closed outcome literal classifying this state change.

processId.description: Workflow process URN this task belongs to.

provenanceRecordRef.description: Optional URN of the provenance record that captures this outcome (Kernel S8). Present when the runtime has stamped the record before emission.

TaskOutcomeKind.description: Closed wire taxonomy for `TaskOutcomeEvent.outcome` (ADR 0082 D-12). Reserved literals: `submitted` (final response committed); `completed` (task response committed and case mutated); `dismissed` (resumable UI dismissal, not a kernel terminal transition); `expired` (SLA breach without submission); `delegated` (assignment changed via delegation); `escalated` (assignment escalated to a higher authority); `drafted` (a draft save event for downstream observers). No vendor-extension seam: these are the outcomes the public API surfaces to clients; richer kernel-side events live in provenance.

TaskPage.description: Cursor-paginated task page (ADR 0082 D-7). Items are `TaskListItem` projections for inbox-style consumption.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page. Omitted when hasMore is false.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available from the server.

items.description: Task list items in this page.

TaskProgressionContinuation.description: Continues the original committed submission using retained server-side inputs. No new submission or operation key.

acceptedCommandRef.description: Nonsecret owner-issued accepted operation reference; grants no authority.

TaskProgressionReference.description: Identifies one original committed submission. Does not assert that its subsequent work has settled.

acceptedCommandRef.description: Nonsecret owner-issued accepted operation reference; grants no authority.

parentCommitted.description: The original native submission parent is committed; later child work may remain unsettled.

TaskProgressionResult.description: Original submission continuation returned under current original actor authority. The outcome reference does not grant access or assert external delivery.

acceptedCommandRef.description: Nonsecret owner-issued accepted operation reference; grants no authority.

applied.description: The owning original continuation returned successfully under current authority.

outcomeRef.description: Nonsecret reference to the original owning outcome; grants no authority.

parentCommitted.description: The original native submission parent is committed; later child work may remain unsettled.

TaskStatus.description: Closed user-facing task lifecycle for the public API (ADR 0082 D-12). The kernel runtime carries a richer `created|assigned|claimed|delegated|escalated` set on `wos-process.schema.json#/$defs/ActiveTask.status` for processor-side bookkeeping; the public API collapses those into the user-visible posture: `pending` (the actor has work to do); `drafted` (a partial response is saved); `submitted` (the actor's final response is committed and the task is no longer actionable); `dismissed` (the actor dismissed the UI; Kernel §13.4 leaves the governed task resumable in its current state); `expired` (the SLA `targetDuration` elapsed without submission and the breach policy fired). No vendor-extension seam: the user-facing taxonomy is closed by design; richer kernel-side states surface in provenance and on `TaskOutcomeEvent.outcome`.

TaskSubmission.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/response`. The endpoint commits a final task response. The `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header is REQUIRED (ADR 0082 D-16). Successful submission transitions the task to `submitted`, fires the kernel `taskCompleted` event, and projects the response into case state via the workflow's `responseMappingRef`. Submission against a non-`pending`/`drafted` task is rejected with `WOS-1409`.

definitionUrl.description: Form or contract definition URL the response was authored against. MUST match the task's pinned `definitionUrl`.

definitionVersion.description: Form or contract definition version. MUST match the task's pinned `definitionVersion`.

response.description: Final response payload conforming to the task's contract.

signatureRef.description: Optional URN of a `SignatureAffirmation` provenance record produced by the signature profile. REQUIRED when `kind == signature`.

signedDraft.description: Signed Source draft selectors and expected values. Required by configured signed-correction tasks and optional for other submissions. These values are preconditions; the server derives the owner, current task, scope and authority and reads the signed record before committing the response.

associationHash.description: Expected hash of the retained Source association.

draftId.description: Opaque identifier of the signed Source draft.

expectedSignedResponseHash.description: Expected hash of the retained signed response.

taskBindingHash.description: Expected hash of the retained current-task binding.

submittedAt.description: Optional client-observed UTC RFC 3339 timestamp. The server MAY replace with its own receipt time.

TemplateRef.description: Identifier of a delivery-sidecar template (entry template id for inbound logging, notification template key for outbound rendering). Resolution happens against the workflow's delivery sidecar at the server.

TemplateSectionContentType.description: Type of content in this section. 'text': free-text with optional placeholders. 'structured': structured content with labeled fields. 'appeal-rights': standardized appeal rights block (must include filing deadline, review body, continuation status). 'action-required': describes actions the recipient must take. 'contact-information': contact details for questions.

x-lm.intent: Classifies the section content for rendering and validation of due process requirements

TimeRange.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 time interval used by report inputs to bound the data set.

end.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 upper bound for the report's data window.

start.description: Inclusive UTC RFC 3339 lower bound for the report's data window.

TimerBreachInput.description: Input parameters for the timer-breach report. Lists kernel timer expirations and hold breaches over the requested time window (Kernel S9 timers, Governance S5 holds).

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the timer-breach input variant.

timeRange.description: UTC time window over which timer-breach events are gathered.

workflowUrl.description: Author-time workflow URL to scope the report to. Omit to span all visible workflows.

TimerBreachRow.description: Per-event result row for the timer-breach report.

breachKind.description: Closed source of the breach event. timer-fired is a kernel timer expiration; hold-expired is a governance hold expiry.

breachedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the breach event.

holdId.description: Hold URN when breachKind is hold-expired.

processId.description: Workflow process URN whose timer or hold breached.

reportType.description: Discriminator literal selecting the timer-breach row variant.

timerId.description: Timer URN when breachKind is timer-fired.

TokenIntrospection.description: Token introspection response returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/introspect` for the bearer token presented on the request. Modeled after RFC 7662 (OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection) with WOS-specific scope and assurance fields. The `active` flag is the load-bearing field: when false, all other fields except possibly `expiresAt` MAY be omitted (the server is asserting the token does not authenticate). Service-account and workload calls (per VISION §V) use this endpoint to verify their token's continuing validity without round-tripping a real read.

active.description: True when the bearer token is currently valid (signature verified, not expired, not revoked, not bumped by a global-logout `auth_epoch` rotation). False otherwise.

actorRef.description: URN of the principal the token authenticates. Omitted when `active == false`.

assuranceLevel.description: Authentication-assurance level attested by this session (ADR 0068 D-3.1 — Accepted). Omitted when `active == false`.

expiresAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 expiry timestamp. Present when `active == true`; MAY be present when `active == false` if the deployment chooses to disclose that the token had expired (rather than been revoked).

issuedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the token was issued.

loginKind.description: Credential family used to obtain the original session. Omitted when `active == false`.

mfaSatisfied.description: True when the session has satisfied a second-factor challenge. Omitted when `active == false`.

scope.description: Active scope tuple bound to the token (ADR 0082 D-9). Omitted when `active == false`.

tokenKind.description: Closed token-kind taxonomy. Always `bearer` at v1. Omitted when `active == false`.

TokenKind.description: Closed token-kind taxonomy. Closed-no-extension by design — the public WOS API contract carries opaque JWT bearer tokens only (ADR 0082 D-9). The `bearer` literal is a single-element enum to keep the wire shape extensible by major schema bump if a second token kind ever lands.

asOf.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the count was computed.

count.description: Current unread notification count visible to the caller.

ValidationOutcome.description: Most recent WOS validation wrapper for a Formspec-backed task response (Kernel §13.6; wos-process.schema.json#/$defs/ValidationOutcome). The three booleans are the validation axes: Formspec response envelope validity, task-pin match, and Formspec definition validation over response.data.

^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.$comment: Vendor-extension fields for deployment-local validation metadata.

definitionValid.description: Whether Formspec Definition validation over response.data passed.

envelopeValid.description: Whether the response envelope validated against Formspec response.schema.json.

errors.description: WOS-level validation errors, including envelope and pin errors. Empty when all three validation axes pass.

items.description: Single WOS validation error. Carries a human-readable message plus optional machine-readable code and location.

code.description: Optional deployment or validator error code.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer or form path naming the failing response location.

pinMatch.description: Whether response.definitionUrl and response.definitionVersion matched the task's pinned contract reference.

validationResults.description: Formspec-shaped ValidationResult entries from Definition validation. Omitted when envelope validation or pin validation prevents definition validation from running.

items.description: Single Formspec validation result projected through the WOS wrapper.

path.description: Optional Formspec field path or JSON Pointer associated with the validation result.

WorkflowProcess.description: Public workflow-process resource (ADR 0082 D-3). Carries identity, workflow binding, lifecycle posture, current configuration, `impactLevel` (Kernel S6 proportionality index), and `caseState` only; subresources are accessed via dedicated endpoints or the closed `?include=` aggregation seam (`WorkflowProcessWithIncludes`). Mirrors structural fields from the kernel runtime artifact `wos-process.schema.json` but is a wire projection: identifiers are URNs (D-4), `lifecycleState` is the closed posture taxonomy (not the kernel raw `status`), and subresource fields (`activeTasks`, `timers`, `holds`, etc.) are intentionally absent.

caseLedgerId.description: Durable governed case-ledger URN (`urn:wos:<tenant>_case_<ulid>`). Multiple workflow runtime processes may append to the same case ledger.

caseState.description: Authoritative case-file snapshot at this projection point (Kernel S5).

configuration.description: Ordered active leaf-state configuration at the time of this projection (Kernel S4.2). Empty for terminal instances.

continuationOfServicesActive.description: True when the case is operating under a continuation-of-services policy (governance §3.6 — `AppealMechanism.continuationOfServices`; workflow-governance.md:154-158). Surfaces the existence of the policy without leaking the underlying policy rationale; the staff caseworker uses this to avoid premature termination during an active appeal window.

continuationOfServicesEndsAt.description: Absolute UTC RFC 3339 timestamp at which the active continuation-of-services window closes, or the literal `never` for indefinite continuation (governance §3.6). Present only when `continuationOfServicesActive == true`.

correlationKey.description: Cross-case correlation identifier used by the kernel to route events to related instances (Kernel S9.4). OPTIONAL; absent when no correlation is in effect.

createdAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the instance was created.

dcrZones.description: Per-instance DCR constraint-zone state (advanced/advanced-governance.md §1.2). Empty when the workflow declares no constraint zones or none have transitioned out of `none`. Cross-cite Agent B's `dcrZoneViolation` Facts record kind for the per-event detail in provenance.

id.description: Stable public URN for this runtime process projection. In the case/process route surface this is the canonical runtime-process identity; the durable case ledger is carried separately by `caseLedgerId`.

impactLevel.description: Closed-with-vendor-extension kernel impact level (Kernel S6; kernel:826) projected from the governing Workflow Document. REQUIRED — the kernel makes `impactLevel` REQUIRED on every Workflow Document and uses it as a proportionality index for governance, AI-oversight, and review-protocol gating; surfacing it on the case projection lets clients branch on `rights-impacting` / `safety-impacting` cases without re-fetching the workflow.

lifecycleState.description: Closed lifecycle posture for this instance.

milestonesFired.description: Set of milestone identifiers fired on this case so far (Kernel S4 milestones; kernel:661-672). Sorted lexicographically. Companion: Agent B's `milestoneFired` literal on `FactsRecordKind` carries the per-event detail; this field is the cumulative set on the live instance projection.

outcomeCode.description: Machine-readable terminal-outcome marker. Populated only when `lifecycleState == completed` (Kernel S6 final-state `outcomeCode`); absent on every other lifecycle state.

processId.description: Workflow runtime process URN (`urn:wos:<tenant>_process_<ulid>`) that owns this live execution projection. Direct case-ledger appends omit process identity; `WorkflowProcess` resources always carry it.

stalledSince.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp recording when the instance entered `stalled` posture (ADR 0070 D-5). REQUIRED on the wire whenever `lifecycleState == stalled`; absent otherwise.

tenant.description: Deployment tenant for this workflow process (ADR 0068 D-1.1). Single DNS label: lowercase ASCII letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, or hyphen, length 1 to 63.

updatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the projection was last refreshed.

workflowUrl.description: Absolute URI of the governing WOS Workflow Document.

workflowVersion.description: Version of the Workflow Document pinned at instance creation (Kernel S9.6). Running instances remain on their creation-time version unless explicitly migrated.

WorkflowProcessCreateRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/processes` in the reference server. Servers create or accept the process identifier, bind it to the durable case ledger, pin `definitionVersion` when supplied, and set the initial `caseState` from `initialCaseState` when present.

definitionUrl.description: Absolute URI of the WOS Workflow Document this process is created against.

definitionVersion.description: Optional pinned Workflow Document version for this process.

initialCaseState.description: Optional initial case-state object applied to the newly bound process.

processId.description: Optional caller-supplied workflow process TypeID or WOS process URN. When omitted, the server allocates a new process TypeID for the supplied case ledger.

tenant.description: Explicit deployment tenant for this instance (ADR 0068 D-1.1). When omitted, the server resolves it from `X-WOS-Tenant`.

WorkflowProcessHoldList.description: Holds subresource for a workflow process (ADR 0082 D-3). Returns active holds; small, bounded set per instance, so not cursor-paginated.

items.description: Engaged holds, ordered by `engagedAt` ascending.

processId.description: Workflow process these holds belong to.

WorkflowUrl.description: Absolute URI of the governing WOS Workflow Document. Together with `workflowVersion` pins the exact author-time document controlling the case lifecycle.

WorkflowUrn.description: Absolute URI of the WOS workflow document this correspondence is associated with. Identifies the delivery sidecar that supplies templates and entry-template metadata.

WosResourceUrn.description: Public WOS API resource URN (ADR 0092 D-1). Shape `urn:wos:<typeid>` — 3-segment URN whose namespace-specific string IS the TypeID. Strip `urn:wos:` to extract the canonical TypeID. The TypeID prefix carries the record family (`case | process | prov | gov | ai | assurance`); `case` identifies the durable case ledger, while `process` identifies a workflow runtime process bound to that ledger.
